stories.title: Illegal arms factory found in tunnel under cupboard:BCA student was operating it in Meerut, supplied weapons on demand
stories.summary: Late Tuesday night in Meerut, police busted an illegal arms factory. The entrance to it was made from inside an almirah. A tunnel was built under the floor of the almirah. As soon as the police entered the tunnel, they saw illegal weapons being manufactured there. Police arrested 4 people from the spot. A BCA student is also among the factory operators. Police found one half-made pistol and two finished pistols at the scene. In addition, welding and lathe machines used for making weapons were also recovered. The entire incident is from Khardauni village in the Incholi police station area. Police revealed this on Wednesday afternoon. About 15 days ago, a similar case came to light in Meerut, where a weapon manufacturing factory was caught under a bed. First, see 2 pictures Now the full case in detail In Meerut, Incholi police station and SWAT team received information from an informant that a country-made pistol factory was operating in Khardauni village. Late Tuesday night, police raided a house in the village. A wardrobe was kept in one of the rooms here. A country-made pistol factory was operating right below it. Upon opening the wardrobe door, a path leading downwards was revealed. The police entered through this tunnel-like passage. There, they found illegal weapons being manufactured. Police arrested four accused, including Imran, from the spot. Umang Thakur, a BCA student, also works as a smuggler in this gang. According to the police, Imran is said to be the most cunning among the accused. He was also sent to jail 25 years ago on charges of running an illegal arms factory. After a long time out, he again built his network. Once again, he started manufacturing country-made pistols on a large scale. SP Rural Abhijeet Kumar Singh said - Based on information from an informant, the police team reached the illegal factory. From the spot, one semi-finished and two ready-made country-made pistols, 36 springs, 45 barrels, and several pieces of 12-bore barrels were seized. In addition, 115 spring cases, tools for making weapons such as a vice, wrench, screwdriver, pliers, bench vice and chisel, 41 drill bits, grinder, welding rod, saw, and file were recovered. The network is being investigated by interrogating the accused. Each accused was playing a different role Among the arrested accused, Imran used to make pistols. While Kuldeep was the main supplier. Narendra acted as an intermediary. Umang Thakur is studying BCA from a college in the city. He also supplied weapons on demand. Narendra used to bring customers for pistols to Kuldeep. He acted as a mediator between the factory and the customer. Whereas, Umang Thakur alias Deva was responsible for delivering and selling pistols to the last customer. The pistol factory was operating in a basement built under a cupboard in Imran's house. These pistols, after being made here, were supplied on demand. Imran revealed that Kuldeep, Narendra, and Umang were also involved with him in the business. Following this, the police also arrested these three. Cases registered against the accused from Meerut to Delhi Kuldeep, a resident of Daurala in Kheri police station area, has 3 cases registered against him. Imran (40), who was running an arms factory in his house, has 2 cases registered against him under the Arms Act in two police stations in Meerut. He also has one case in Delhi in the same matter. Similarly, Narendra, a resident of Andawali in Incholi, also has cases registered against him in connection with weapons at Mawana, Incholi, and Gangnagar police stations in Meerut.

stories.title: 2 Indian journalists Anand Suparna win Pulitzer:Honour awarded for reporting mental harassment of digital arrest victim from Lucknow
stories.summary: Anand RK and Suparna Sharma have won the Pulitzer Prize for their crucial investigative reporting that exposed cybercrime. They received this honor in the Illustrated Reporting and Commentary category, along with Natalie Obiko Pearson. This award, known as the 'Nobel of Journalism,' was given to them for the special report 'Trapped,' prepared for Bloomberg. What is the report about? The report 'Trapped,' created by this journalistic duo, exposes the terrifying system of 'digital arrest' through the true story of Lucknow-based neurologist Ruchira Tandon. This unique blend of Anand's powerful illustrations and Suparna's in-depth journalism shows how cybercriminals use technology to mentally hold a person captive. This story is not just a personal tragedy, but also a serious warning about the misuse of surveillance systems and the growing organised digital scams on a global scale. Anand has also won the Eisner Award Anand RK, who lives in Mumbai, is an illustrator and visual artist. In 2021, he also won the Eisner Award for 'Best Painter/Multimedia Artist' with colorist John Pearson for the graphic novel 'Blue in Green', published by Image Comics. Anand, a graduate of Sir JJ School of Art, has illustrated works such as Dark Horse Comics' 'Graffities Wall', Vault's 'Radio Apocalypse', and DC Comics' 'Resurrection Man'. He has created cover art for publishers such as Boom! Studios, 2000 AD, Tiny Onion, and Image Comics. He has also worked with clients such as Hyundai, the Indian Navy, ImagineFX Magazine, and Heavy Metal Magazine. Suparna has exposed negligence in care centers Suparna is a freelance investigative journalist and editor. She has three decades of experience reporting on crime, conflict, disasters, and corruption. In 2023, her investigation for Al Jazeera into a devastating fire at a care facility in Delhi exposed negligence in the elder care sector and alleged attempts to suppress the truth. Aniruddha, of Indian origin, also a winner Aniruddha Ghosal, an Indian-origin journalist living in Hanoi, won the Pulitzer in the International Reporting category. Aniruddha, associated with the Associated Press (AP), reported on surveillance equipment developed in Silicon Valley and China by the US Border Patrol. Meanwhile, Devjyot, an Indian-origin journalist from Bangkok, who exposed the cybercrime and human trafficking nexus in Southeast Asia, was a finalist.

stories.title: UP ATS nabs 2 suspected terrorists planning attacks on police:Were in contact with Pakistani gangsters
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS) has uncovered a major terror module and arrested two young men. They were allegedly in touch with a network linked to Pakistan and were planning attacks on sensitive locations in the country. The arrested accused have been identified as Daniyal Ashraf (23) from Barabanki and Krishna Mishra (20) from Kushinagar. According to officials, both were in contact with suspected Pakistani gangsters, including Shahzad Bhatti, Abid Jatt and Hammad. Krishna was arrested in Gorakhpur, while Daniyal was caught in Barabanki. Investigators say both were working together as part of the suspected plan. An ATS spokesperson said that both of them were conspiring to attack important establishments, police stations, and uniformed personnel at the behest of the Pakistani intelligence agency ISI and Pakistani gangster Shahzad Bhatti. ATS had received information that Pakistani terrorist organisations were recruiting Indian youth as foot soldiers and sleeper cells through social media (especially Instagram). These youths were being radicalised by offering financial incentives at the behest of Pakistani gangsters Shahzad Bhatti, Abid Jatt, and Hammad. Their objective was to endanger the unity, integrity, and sovereignty of the country by attacking sensitive institutions, police stations, outposts, and police personnel. During interrogation, it was revealed that both accused were in contact with Pakistani handlers. Their phones had numbers saved for Shahzad Bhatti, Abid Jatt, and Hammad. Evidence of video calls, voice notes, WhatsApp chats, and anti-national conversations were found with them. Daniyal Ashraf had made a reconnaissance video of a police station in another state and sent it to the handlers. He had also demanded money and weapons (guns) for the attack. Hammad had sent a photo of Abid Jatt labelled 'Pakistani Don', which was to be printed in 50 copies and pasted at important locations. Videos of Shahzad Bhatti and Abid Jatt were found on Krishna Mishra's phone, in which a task was given to shoot a uniformed person and send the video. A reconnaissance video was also recovered in which both handlers had assigned this task to Krishna and his two associates. During interrogation, both stated that Shahzad Bhatti had contacted them on Instagram and said, "If you work according to my instructions, I will make you a hero in India." UP ATS recovered one country-made pistol (9 mm), one .315 bore country-made pistol, 6 live cartridges (9 mm), and two mobile phones from them. Who are the accused? Krishna Mishra: Son of Chhotelal Mishra, Age 20 years. Original resident of Harpur village, Jatahan Bazar police station, Kushinagar. Currently resides in Belwamishra, Ravindranagar police station, Kushinagar. Daniyal Ashraf: Son of Mahmood Ansari, Age 23 years. Resident of Kintoor village, Badosarai police station, Barabanki.

stories.title: ₹ 20 lakh looted from ATM cash van in Ghaziabad:Driver held hostage, suspects flee after abandoning vehicle amid police cordon
stories.summary: Three armed men allegedly robbed an ATM cash van carrying around Rs 20 lakh in Ghaziabad on Wednesday afternoon. The incident took place around 1 pm in the Crossings Republik police station area, about 7 km from the district headquarters. The cash van belonged to India One company. The accused allegedly held the driver hostage at gunpoint and fired in the air before fleeing with the vehicle towards Hapur through the Delhi-Meerut Expressway. The driver was later forced out of the van after being threatened. Police launched a search operation soon after receiving information about the robbery. Around 8 km from the spot, the abandoned cash van was found on the Delhi-Meerut Expressway. However, the cash kept inside the vehicle was missing. Driver taken hostage after being found alone Near the HP petrol pump, an India One ATM booth is located around 50 metres inside a lane from the main road. Around 1 pm on Wednesday, four company employees arrived there in the cash van to load money into the ATM. The guard and two employees went inside the ATM booth carrying cash boxes, while the driver remained seated inside the van. Seeing him alone, three armed men allegedly attacked the van and held the driver hostage at gunpoint. When the driver tried to resist, the accused allegedly fired in the air. Frightened by the firing, the driver did not resist further and the accused escaped with the cash van. The driver later raised an alarm, after which local residents gathered at the spot. Police launched a city-wide checking operation soon after receiving information about the robbery. Around two hours later, the van was recovered in the Masuri police station area. However, the cash kept inside the vehicle was missing. Around Rs 20 lakh was inside the van According to the cash van employees, they had collected nearly Rs 25 lakh from a bank before reaching the ATM. Around Rs 5 lakh had already been taken inside for loading into the ATM when the robbery took place. At the time of the incident, around Rs 20 lakh was still inside the cash van, which the accused allegedly fled with. The abandoned cash van was later found parked on the Delhi-Meerut Expressway. Accused were roaming near the cash van on foot DCP City Dhaval Jaiswal said preliminary investigation suggests that the three accused were walking near the area where the cash van was parked. The company employees had taken the cash boxes inside the ATM machine for loading money. Taking advantage of the situation, the accused allegedly targeted the van after noticing that the driver was alone. Police said the accused escaped towards Hapur after leaving the Delhi-Meerut Expressway. The district border of Hapur is located ahead of the Masuri area, and investigators suspect the accused fled in that direction. Police assessing exact amount looted DCP Dhaval Jaiswal said police are verifying the exact amount stolen from the cash van. Records have been sought to determine how much money had already been deposited into the ATM and how much cash remained inside the van. Eight police teams have been formed to investigate the case. Officials are examining CCTV footage from nearby areas and questioning the company employees and driver as part of the investigation.

stories.title: Kanpur’s Hallet Hospital to launch AI eye lab:Doctors to practise on robotic eyes first; patients to get safer, pain-free treatment
stories.summary: The LLR Hospital (Hallet), affiliated with Ganesh Shankar Vidyarthi Memorial Medical College, is set to become a high-tech medical training centre with the launch of an AI-based skill lab in its ophthalmology department. The facility is expected to become operational within the next three to four months. Head of the Ophthalmology Department, Dr Parvez Khan, said the lab is currently under development and will allow doctors and medical students to practise procedures on advanced machines and simulators before treating patients. Direct practice on patients to end At present, junior doctors and medical students in many medical colleges often learn eye examinations and minor procedures directly on patients. This can sometimes cause discomfort to patients and increase the possibility of errors. With the introduction of the AI-based lab, students will first undergo extensive training on advanced AI models and simulators. Only after gaining complete control over procedures and techniques will they be allowed to perform treatments on real patients. Training for MBBS, MS and optometry students The new facility will provide specialised training to students at every level. MS surgery students will be trained in complex ophthalmic procedures, while MBBS students will learn the fundamentals of eye anatomy and primary treatment methods. Optometry students will also receive hands-on training in identifying accurate spectacle power and operating advanced ophthalmic equipment. Officials said the lab aims to provide world-class training under one roof. AI models to simulate human eye response One of the key features of the lab will be AI-powered models designed to respond like the human body. Students will practise measuring eye pressure — an essential procedure for detecting diseases such as glaucoma. The simulators will also help students repeatedly practise delicate post-surgery suturing techniques, reducing the risk of technical errors and complications during real operations. Focus on patient safety and better treatment According to Dr Parvez Khan, the primary objective of the initiative is to improve patient safety and treatment quality. He said regular practice on simulators would help doctors gain confidence and precision before handling patients. Work on the lab is progressing rapidly, and preparations are underway to inaugurate the facility within the next 100 days. Once operational, Hallet Hospital will become one of the few centres in Uttar Pradesh to use advanced AI technology for training eye specialists.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav ends I-PAC contract ahead of UP elections:SP leader says, ‘I don’t have money’; firm handled Mamata Banerjee’s poll campaign
stories.summary: After the West Bengal election results, the Samajwadi Party has ended its contract with election strategy firm I-PAC. Addressing a press conference in Lucknow, party chief Akhilesh Yadav said, “Yes, we had ties with them. They worked with us for a few months. But now we are unable to continue because we are facing a fund crunch and cannot afford to pay such huge amounts.” Akhilesh said, Some people advised us to hire companies that claim to win elections. They suggested getting surveys done through C-Voter. They said an AVM company should be brought on board. For negative campaigns against opponents on social media, they recommended joining hands with a 360-degree campaign company and funding it. I-PAC was also handling the election campaign of Mamata Banerjee-led All India Trinamool Congress in West Bengal. For the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Akhilesh had entrusted I-PAC with preparing the Samajwadi Party’s electoral strategy. The consultancy firm had earlier played a key role in the victories of Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam in Tamil Nadu and the Trinamool Congress in West Bengal in 2021. Stalin and Mamata had advised Akhilesh to hire I-PAC For the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections and to take on Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav had signed a deal with election strategy firm I-PAC. The company was founded by political strategist Prashant Kishor and is considered India’s first professional election consultancy firm. However, PK has distanced himself from the company in recent years. I-PAC is now being run by people such as Prateek Jain, who are also working with the All India Trinamool Congress and Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam. Sources said Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M K Stalin and West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee had advised Akhilesh to hire I-PAC. Akhilesh held his first meeting with company officials in Delhi in December 2025. He met them again during his visit to West Bengal in January this year. After that, the Samajwadi Party hired I-PAC. The Samajwadi Party has given data analysis and strategy-related work to Mumbai-based Showtime Consulting. Survey work is being handled by a Karnataka-based company. According to sources, I-PAC was assigned the task of managing the election campaign, training booth-level workers, increasing voter turnout through app-based tools, and focusing on weaknesses of opposition parties. I-PAC is India’s first professional election consultancy company, but PK has distanced himself from it in recent years. PK has prepared strategies for several political parties Prashant Kishor, popularly known as PK in political circles, has successfully managed several major election campaigns through I-PAC. He prepared the strategy for the Bharatiya Janata Party’s 2014 Lok Sabha campaign. In 2015, he helped Nitish Kumar win in Bihar. In 2017, he worked with Amarinder Singh in Punjab. PK’s company also played a key role in the victories of Mamata Banerjee’s Trinamool Congress and Stalin’s DMK. Who is Prashant Kishor? Prashant Kishor entered Indian politics in 2011 after resigning from the United Nations. In 2014, he worked on Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s election campaign. After its success, he founded I-PAC. After launching his Jan Suraaj Party in Bihar, he distanced himself from the company. Ahead of the 2025 Bihar Assembly elections, he decided not to contest polls and instead focused on strengthening the organisation. Prashant Kishor has worked in UP before Prashant Kishor has worked in Uttar Pradesh earlier as well. During the 2017 Assembly elections, he prepared the Congress campaign strategy and coined the slogan “27 Saal UP Behaal”. However, after the Congress formed an alliance with the Samajwadi Party, the campaign lost momentum and the slogan had to be dropped midway. Even after the alliance, the Congress won only seven seats, while the Samajwadi Party suffered a major defeat and was reduced to 47 seats.

stories.title: Rajbhar attacks Akhilesh over no-show in Bengal poll:'Will now meet Mamata in AC comfort, ask her to campaign in UP'
stories.summary: Ahead of Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav’s proposed visit to West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh minister and Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party (SBSP) president Om Prakash Rajbhar mocked him for staying away from the state during the Assembly election campaign. In an X post on Wednesday, Rajbhar said Mamata Banerjee had been waiting for weeks for Akhilesh to visit Bengal, but he stayed away because of the heat and campaign pressure. He said Akhilesh preferred posting tweets “after waking up in the afternoon”, instead of attending rallies and roadshows. Rajbhar further alleged that Akhilesh would blame Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) if the SP loses the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. He claimed Akhilesh was creating a narrative around EVMs to justify a future defeat. Earlier this week, Rajbhar described Akhilesh as a leader of “tweets, AC and PC”. Akhilesh likely to meet Mamata in Kolkata Akhilesh Yadav is expected to visit Kolkata on Wednesday to meet outgoing West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee. The visit comes after the BJP’s victory in the West Bengal Assembly elections, where the party won 207 of the 294 seats, while the TMC was reduced to 80 seats. Speaking at a press conference in Kolkata on Tuesday, Mamata said Akhilesh had wanted to visit a day earlier, but she asked him to come on Wednesday instead. She also said leaders of opposition parties would meet one by one and reiterated her commitment to strengthening the INDIA alliance. SP chief stayed away from Bengal campaign Akhilesh Yadav did not campaign in West Bengal during the Assembly elections. He neither addressed rallies nor visited the state during the campaign period. However, he remained active on social media and repeatedly extended support to Mamata Banerjee. After the election results, Akhilesh posted several messages on X targeting the BJP and the Centre. In one post, he called the BJP’s victory “fraudulent”. In another, he shared a video alleging misconduct by security personnel during counting. He also criticised the BJP over women’s reservation. Akhilesh had earlier visited Kolkata in January along with his wife and MP Dimple Yadav. During the visit, he met Mamata Banerjee and announced SP’s support for the TMC in the elections. The SP did not field candidates in any constituency in Bengal. Akhilesh accuses BJP of 'looting votes' in Bengal Addressing party workers in Lucknow on Tuesday, Akhilesh accused the BJP of misusing the administration and “looting votes” in West Bengal. He claimed the BJP was worried about the PDA (Backward, Dalit and Minority) alliance in Uttar Pradesh. He also reiterated the SP’s support for women’s reservation and demanded that representation should be based on caste census data and population share. Akhilesh urged party workers to remain alert ahead of the 2027 UP Assembly elections and asked them to monitor voter lists closely. He said the elections would be crucial for protecting democracy and the Constitution.

stories.title: Kanpur BJP leaders ditch ‘neta look’ in Bengal campaign:Suresh Awasthi says winning people’s trust helped the party secure victory
stories.summary: Senior BJP leader Suresh Awasthi, who returned after campaigning in the West Bengal Assembly elections, claimed that fear of the ruling Trinamool Congress (TMC) was visible among voters during the polls. He alleged that Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee tried to create a narrative that people from other states wanted to “occupy” Bengal. “The way Mamata Banerjee created an atmosphere from the stage, saying people from Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and Gujarat wanted to come and occupy Bengal, was completely misleading,” Awasthi said. He added that BJP workers were instructed by senior leaders to avoid making controversial speeches from the stage and instead focus on grassroots campaigning. ‘People were afraid to openly support BJP’ Awasthi claimed that many voters were scared to openly express support for the BJP because of alleged pressure from TMC workers. “People there used to say that TMC workers would ask whom they would vote for. Out of fear, they would take the name of TMC itself,” he said. According to him, voters also alleged that in previous elections, their voter ID cards were taken away. He claimed the situation improved this time because central forces were deployed early by the Election Commission. Kanpur BJP leaders handled over 40 seats Several BJP leaders from Kanpur were sent to West Bengal for election duties. These included MP Ramesh Awasthi, MLAs Abhijit Singh Sanga and Mahesh Trivedi, along with MLC Arun Pathak. Party leaders said Kanpur leaders were given responsibility for more than 40 Assembly seats in Bengal, out of which BJP won 35 seats. Ramesh Awasthi handled administrative responsibility for 26 seats and BJP won 22 of them. Senior BJP leader Suresh Awasthi stayed in Bengal for nearly two-and-a-half months and was assigned the Bagda Assembly constituency near the Bangladesh border. BJP leaders claim workers feared TMC pressure Suresh Awasthi said he reached Bengal even before the model code of conduct came into force. “Initially, we stayed at a BJP worker’s house for around 20 days, but the family became scared because of pressure from TMC workers and local police,” he claimed. He added that even hotel owners advised BJP leaders not to openly wear party scarves while moving around. “They told us to wear the BJP scarf only after moving some distance away from the hotel,” he said. Campaigning near Bangladesh border was biggest challenge Awasthi said the Bagda Assembly seat near the Bangladesh border was one of the toughest constituencies for the BJP. The BJP had fielded Soma Thakur from the seat. In the previous election, TMC had won there by nearly 12,000 votes. He claimed that after the NRC issue, the number of Hindu voters in the area had reduced. According to him, campaigning in some border areas required CRPF security. stories.title: Doctor claims rape at gym run from minister brother’s property:Accused blackmail victim with secret videos; both arrested
stories.summary: A 40-year-old MBBS doctor in Uttar Pradesh’s Bareilly has alleged that she was raped and blackmailed by two brothers who operated a gym in the Civil Lines area. The gym was running on the upper floor of a building owned by the brother of Cabinet Minister Dharampal Singh. Police said the accused have been identified as Akram Beg and Alam Beg, who ran the ‘Ultimate Fitness Gym’ in Civil Lines, opposite the main post office. The gym has reportedly been operating for nearly 10 years. Doctor alleges intoxicating drink was given According to police, the woman had been visiting the gym for around two years. She alleged that the accused offered her a “pre-workout drink” in the name of rapid weight loss. The drink allegedly contained an intoxicating substance, after which she became unconscious. Police said the accused then took her to a private room inside the gym, where Akram Beg allegedly raped her. Investigators said hidden cameras had been installed in the room and obscene videos were also recorded on a mobile phone. Nude videos allegedly used for extortion The woman doctor told police that in April, the accused showed her the videos and allegedly demanded ₹10 lakh to stop them from being made public. She later stopped going to the gym. According to the complaint, both brothers later reached her house and allegedly threatened to make the videos viral unless she paid ₹50 lakh. The woman claimed she paid ₹80,000 out of fear, but the threats continued. Police arrest both accused Following the complaint, police formed three teams and arrested Akram Beg. Based on his interrogation, police recovered a pendrive containing obscene videos and seized his mobile phone. Police later arrested Alam Beg and recovered another pendrive and a mobile phone from him. During the search, officials also found suspicious medicines, testosterone boosters and syringes inside the gym. Police suspect more victims Police said the accused admitted to recording obscene videos of several other women allegedly to extort money from them. Officials added that multiple cases of assault and molestation were already registered against Alam Beg.

stories.title: Vrindavan boat tours resume, days after river tragedy:Life jackets are now mandatory, but safety gaps still remain
stories.summary: “We will operate the boats with complete safety arrangements. Only 15 passengers will be allowed on board after being made to wear life jackets so that such an accident does not recur. People often enter the deep waters of the Yamuna for bathing. We try to stop them, but they do not listen. The administration should also focus on installing barricades and warning boards.” These remarks were made by boatmen at Keshi Ghat in Vrindavan, Mathura, where 16 tourists lost their lives in a boat accident on April 10. Boat operations remained suspended for 23 days after the tragedy and resumed on May 3 after compliance with safety norms and payment of registration fees. Dainik Bhaskar visited the ghat to assess the situation after the accident — whether safety norms were being followed, whether passengers were being provided life jackets, and how alert the administration remained after the tragedy. Devotees are gradually returning to Keshi Ghat The team first visited Keshi Ghat, where the accident had taken place. The atmosphere at the ghat has changed significantly. The area, once crowded and bustling with activity, now appears relatively quiet. However, normalcy is slowly returning. Devotees have started visiting the ghat again, while boats have resumed operations on the Yamuna after a gap of nearly 23 days. Passengers are now being made to wear life jackets during boat rides. Boatmen prepare rides, but fewer visitors Several boatmen were seen preparing their boats along the riverbank. Some were painting the vessels, while others were engaged in cleaning work. Only a few motorboats were seen operating in the river, with passengers wearing life jackets. Boatmen said it would take time for the earlier crowds to return. Operators assure compliance with safety guidelines A boatman named Prem said the administration had now permitted the resumption of boat services. Referring to the April 10 accident, he said, “We will operate boats with complete safety arrangements. Only 15 passengers will be allowed after being made to wear life jackets. Two drivers will remain on the boat during operations, and they too will wear life jackets. All prescribed standards will be followed strictly.” Prem said the tragedy had served as a lesson for everyone and expressed hope that such an incident would never occur again. Another boatman, Banwari, said the municipal corporation had allowed only 15 passengers per boat and made life jackets mandatory. He added that no passenger would be allowed on board without a life jacket and no boat would carry passengers beyond the permitted capacity. Municipal corporation issuing permits at the ghat The administration has made registration and permits mandatory for operating boats. A municipal corporation team has set up a camp at Keshi Ghat to collect registration fees and issue permits to boatmen. The registration fee has been fixed at ₹1,500 for motorboats and ₹500 for ordinary boats. Boatmen are required to submit Aadhaar cards and photographs to complete the process. Several boatmen said the municipal corporation team was assisting them during registration. Safety arrangements missing along the Yamuna When the Bhaskar team reached the Yamuna riverbank, visible safety arrangements were largely absent. While boatmen appeared to be following safety protocols, people bathing in the river continued to act negligently. Several devotees, including children, were seen bathing in the river despite repeated warnings from boatmen. No warning boards installed by the municipal corporation were visible at the site, nor was there any barricading along the riverbank. Boatmen say devotees ignore repeated warnings Boatman Puran, who has been operating boats for nearly four decades, said only 15 passengers wearing life jackets were being allowed on board and all guidelines were being followed. However, he said people entering the Yamuna often ignored repeated warnings. According to him, barricading that existed earlier had been removed, warning boards were absent, and no water police personnel had been deployed to stop people from entering deep waters, increasing the risk of accidents. Another boatman, Chandrapal Nishad, said business had not yet returned to normal and the number of devotees remained lower than before. He said boatmen repeatedly shouted at people to stop them from entering deep waters, but many, including children and youths, ignored the warnings. He said municipal officials or police personnel should be deployed at the ghats to prevent people from venturing into dangerous areas. Several other boatmen said the Yamuna’s water level remained uneven, with some stretches deep and others shallow, increasing the possibility of accidents. A devotee named Bhagya, who had arrived from Agra, also said no warning boards or barricading were visible near the riverbank. Police deployment soon Mathura Senior Superintendent of Police Shlok Kumar said authorities would monitor those behaving recklessly in the Yamuna and action would be taken against anyone violating safety guidelines. He said water police personnel would soon be deployed and regular patrolling would also be carried out. Mobile teams would remain stationed at the ghats to assist devotees and ensure safety, he added. How the accident unfolded On April 10, a boat carrying tourists from Punjab was around 50 feet away from the riverbank in the middle of the Yamuna when strong winds blowing at nearly 30 kmph destabilised it. The boatman reportedly lost control as the vessel began swaying. Tourists allegedly asked the boatman to stop as a bridge lay ahead, but the boat continued moving. It narrowly avoided collision twice before crashing for the third time and capsizing in the river. Sixteen tourists were killed in the accident.

stories.title: Hardoi child rape-murder accused killed in encounter:Criminal with ₹50,000 bounty gunned down in police shootout
stories.summary: A criminal wanted by police in the case of kidnapping, sexually assaulting and murdering a seven-year-old boy was killed in a police encounter near the Hardoi city in Uttar Pradesh early on Wednesday. The 29-year-old, Mahnoor, alias Shahnoor, alias Mehnuddin, carried a reward of ₹50,000 on his arrest. According to police, Mahnoor was “intercepted” around 3 am in Babtamau, some 50 km from Hardoi, where he allegedly opened fire on the police team. Police retaliated, shooting him in the chest. He later succumbed to his injuries. Investigators said the accused had kidnapped the child on May 3 while he was visiting a fair with friends. Mahnoor allegedly called the victim’s father demanding a ransom of ₹7 lakh. Preliminary investigation revealed that after the ransom was not paid, and the child was later on sexually assaulted and murdered. Following which, the body was buried in a field. Police traced the ransom call to Kanpur and arrested two accused there on Tuesday. Based on their interrogation, the child’s body was recovered and Mahnoor’s identity came to light. Police then announced a reward for his arrest. Officials said Mahnoor, a resident of Kannauj, had at least 12 criminal cases registered against him and was known for frequently changing his identity using multiple names. stories.title: Hailstorm batters Ghaziabad, rain lashes Noida and Prayagraj:100 quintals of wheat damaged in Ghazipur; thunderstorm, rain alert in 45 UP districts
stories.summary: Storms and rain have continued to sweep across Uttar Pradesh for the past six days, bringing major relief from the scorching summer heat. While Wednesday morning began with clear skies, sunshine and cool winds in several districts, heavy rain and hailstorms lashed many parts of the state late on Tuesday night. Ghaziabad witnessed strong winds followed by heavy rainfall and hail in the Loni area, while Noida, Prayagraj and Mirzapur also received intense showers. In Ghazipur, nearly 100 quintals of wheat stored at a procurement centre were soaked after rainwater entered the warehouse area, raising fears of major crop losses. According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), a western disturbance combined with snowfall in the Himalayan region has triggered unstable weather conditions across the state. Moisture-laden winds from the Bay of Bengal colliding with dry western winds have led to thunderstorms, hail and widespread rain activity. Maximum temperatures across Uttar Pradesh have now dropped below 40°C, offering relief from the prolonged heatwave. The weather department has issued a rain and thunderstorm alert for 45 districts on Wednesday, warning that wind speeds could reach up to 60 kmph in isolated areas. Meteorologists have also warned of possible hailstorms over the next two days. 45 cities receive heavy rain in 24 hours Heavy rainfall was recorded in at least 45 cities, including Lucknow and Agra, during the past 24 hours. Hamirpur and Chitrakoot witnessed storms with wind speeds touching 70 kmph, uprooting trees and disrupting normal life. In Hamirpur, a woman returning from the fields died after a tin shed collapsed on her during strong winds. Several vehicles were also damaged after walls collapsed in different districts. Barabanki recorded the highest rainfall in the state at 72 mm, followed by Siddharthnagar at 66 mm, Ambedkar Nagar at 42 mm and Gorakhpur at 41.4 mm. Wheat stocks damaged in Ghazipur Recent rainfall exposed poor storage arrangements at wheat procurement centres in Ghazipur. Officials said wheat sacks kept in the open were covered with tarpaulin sheets from above, but water accumulated on the ground seeped into the jute and plastic bags from below. Nearly 100 quintals of wheat are feared to have been damaged. Weather likely to remain unstable till May 10 Lucknow meteorologist Atul Singh said active western disturbances over north India are responsible for the sudden weather shift. He said such atmospheric instability is common during May and the fluctuating weather pattern is expected to continue till May 10. Forecast for next three days May 7: Thunderstorms, rain showers and possible hailstorms are likely across the state. May 8: Western Uttar Pradesh may witness clearer weather, while eastern districts could continue to receive rain and thunderstorms. May 9: Rain activity is likely to persist in eastern Uttar Pradesh along with strong winds, while western regions may remain largely clear.

stories.title: Virat Kohli effect in Lucknow:Tickets rise up to ₹50,000 ahead of RCB vs LSG clash as demand soars among fans
stories.summary: Veteran cricketer Virat Kohli arrived in Lucknow ahead of the IPL clash against Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) and trained for nearly two hours at Ekana Stadium. During the session, Kohli looked in fine touch, smashing multiple sixes and spending time practising against spin bowlers. He later completed fitness drills, including laps around the boundary. A large number of fans gathered outside the stadium, hoping to catch a glimpse of Kohli. However, many left disappointed as entry was restricted during the practice session. The match between Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) and LSG is scheduled for May 7 at Ekana Stadium, with excitement among fans reaching a peak. The buzz is visible both on the ground and across online platforms, with Kohli remaining the biggest attraction. Despite ticket prices doubling, demand continues to surge, and the turnout could set a new attendance record in Lucknow this season. Online ticket prices for the match are currently ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹50,000 — the highest for any game in the city this season so far. Earlier matches had tickets priced between ₹1,000 and ₹25,000. Meanwhile, brokers and touts are reportedly selling RCB vs LSG tickets at several times the original price, further highlighting the massive demand. Lucknow eager to get a glimpse of King Kohli The match scheduled for May 7th is on paper between LSG and RCB, but the ground reality is that fans in Lucknow are coming only to see Virat Kohli. Experts are already calling the match a 'mega show' and declaring it housefull. Highest demand for this category Among the 9 ticket categories, the highest demand is for Rs 6,000 ticket. This is the South VIP Terrace area. The ticket rates for East and West Stand are Rs 2,000. Both these categories have the highest demand. Now know about Kohli's practice session- Cricket fans appeared eager to see Kohli Virat opened up in practice, had a long discussion about the pitch In the practice session that lasted from 5 PM to 8 PM on Tuesday evening, Virat Kohli's focus was on hitting sixes. After warm-up, Virat faced fast bowlers and spinners in the nets for about an hour. During this time, his shots showed the same old aggression and accuracy. After practice, Kohli had a long discussion with head coach Andy Flower about the pitch. RCB's batting depends on Kohli In the current IPL season, Virat Kohli has emerged as the strongest pillar for RCB. He has scored 379 runs in 9 matches played so far with an excellent average of 54.14 and a strike rate of 165.50. It may be noted that in the previous encounter held in Bengaluru on April 15, Virat had also taken Lucknow's bowlers to task. He played an innings of 49 runs (6 fours, 1 six) off just 34 balls, laying the foundation for his team's 5-wicket victory. Now Ekana fans are hoping that on May 7, they will get to see a big innings from Virat's bat. LSG's performance in IPL 2025 so far LSG are currently at the bottom of the IPL points table, placed 10th. The team has lost 7 of their 9 matches so far, managing just two wins — one in Hyderabad and the other in Kolkata. Notably, LSG have failed to register a single victory in their last six matches. The team arrived in Lucknow on Tuesday. Earlier, on Monday, Mumbai Indians handed them a heavy defeat, dealing a major blow to their playoff hopes. LSG’s batting line-up has struggled throughout the season. After nine matches, only three players — Mitchell Marsh (256), Aiden Markram (224) and captain Rishabh Pant (204) — have crossed the 200-run mark. Last season’s key performers Nicholas Pooran and Ayush Badoni have failed to make an impact this time. On the bowling front, while there have been individual performances, the lack of collective effort has hurt the team. Prince Yadav (13 wickets) and Mohsin Khan (10 wickets) have impressed, but Mohammed Shami has been below par, and Avesh Khan has struggled for rhythm.

stories.title: Peon gets his 3 wives appointed as teachers:Turns crorepati by fake teacher scam, ₹2.37 crore routed to third wife; questions raised over officials’ role
stories.summary: Pilibhit's Ilham-ur-Rahman Shamsi was officially a peon, but his influence was nowhere less than to an officer. He allegedly siphoned off nearly ₹9 crore from the Education Department without raising suspicion. The fraud came to light later, following which an FIR was registered. However, Ilham secured anticipatory bail and returned home. The investigation revealed that he had transferred government funds into bank accounts of several relatives, including his three wives, facts that were previously unknown to many. The case has raised several questions: How did a peon begin handling clerical responsibilities in the DIOS office? Why did Treasury Officers not flag the sudden increase in budget allocations? And how did the women remain unaware of his multiple marriages? Read the full story First, let's know about Ilham's personal life... Arrangement with officials, got attached to DIOS office There is a Panjabiyan locality in Pilibhit city itself. 45-year-old Ilham lives here with his family. The lifestyle of the family members is as if they were the family of an officer. Around 2010, Ilham got a government job as a Class IV employee. He was posted at Janta Technical Inter College in Bisalpur near the city. After getting the job, he got married to Arshi Khatun. Neighborhood residents say Ilham used to maintain good relations with the teachers of the college and officials of the education department. He had no quarrel with anyone. Taking advantage of his closeness with officials, in 2014, Ilham got himself attached to the DIOS office. The post there was also of a peon, but gradually he became a favorite of the office babus. He even started telling the babus ways to make money from the system. From peon to 'clerk' with computer knowledge Until before 2018, computers were not involved in most of the work at Pilibhit's DIOS office. Most work was done through files. Ilham was already a master at managing files, but digitalization benefited him even more. The office babus did not have good knowledge of computers, but Ilham was knowledgeable. Due to this, Ilham was given responsibility for financial work like salary bills, token generation, etc. Ilham maintained records of teachers and employees from 35 government inter colleges, high schools, and 22 aided inter colleges in the district. Whenever teachers needed any work done, they would contact Ilham. His colleagues say that sometimes he would come wearing expensive, branded clothes. However, he always behaved very normally in the office. He never talked big. Got married 3 times, and no one even knew Meanwhile, Ilham got married 2 more times. In 2016, he married Azara Khan for the second time. Azara was from Aligarh but lived in Jamun Gali near Jama Masjid in Bulandshahr. After that, he married Lubna from Sambhal for the third time. 32-year-old Lubna lives in Jagat Mohalla in Sambhal. She told police during interrogation that she had no idea about Ilham's two other marriages. Ilham also has a close relationship with Lubna's sister, Fatima Navi. Ilham had sent more than ₹1 crore to her account. Neighbors say that no one knows about the three marriages. The other two wives never came to Pilibhit either. Ilham used to frequently visit Sambhal and Bulandshahr, but such discussions never took place. Ilham's lifestyle had changed over the past few years. Family members also appeared changed. He had bought a lot of land. He was about to make a big investment in Bareilly. Now understand how the game of sending money started Sent money by making wives, sister-in-law, mother-in-law, govt teachers Ilham opened an account for his wife, Arshi Khatoon, at Bank of Baroda on June 6, 2024. Exactly 6 days later, he got his wife's account approved as a 'Salary Account'. Whereas verification is required for this, signatures of senior officers are needed. Ilham got all this work done in just 6 days. Since Ilham himself issued salary tokens, salary also started going into this account from September. When the matter came to light in February 2026, more than ₹1 crore 15 lakh had already been sent to this account. Similarly, Ilham also got accounts attached for his second wife, Azara, third wife Lubna, Lubna's sister Fatima Navi, mother-in-law Nahid, sister-in-law Afia, acquaintance Ashkara, and Parveen Khatoon. All of them were also shown as government teachers, whereas they had nothing to do with studying or teaching. Money came from Treasury 6 times every month Now the question is, when all the work was done so cleanly, how was the matter caught? The entire game starts on September 12, 2024. On this day, ₹1 lakh came into the account of Ilham's wife, Arshi, from the Treasury. On the same day, another ₹1 lakh came from the Treasury. After this, money kept coming from the Treasury 2 to 6 times every month. Till December 17, 2025, money came from the Treasury 98 times. This amount was ₹1 crore 1 lakh. On December 17, ₹36 lakh 41 thousand were withdrawn. When lakhs of rupees came from the Treasury several times every month, the bank became suspicious, because this was a savings account. Arshi was shown as employed, not as a businessperson. The bank informed District Magistrate Gyanendra Singh about this on February 10, 2026. On the DM's instructions, the Chief Development Officer (CDO) sought a report from the District Inspector of Schools (DIOS) Rajeev Kumar. Following this, the DIOS suspended Ilham on February 13. Along with this, an FIR was filed against him and his wife, Arshi, for embezzlement of government funds. However, Ilham escaped arrest as he had obtained anticipatory bail from the court. Actually, salary bills reach the treasury every month only after the DIOS's signature. Then the treasury transfers salaries to the accounts of teachers and other employees. Considering the seriousness of the matter, the DM formed a special 4-member team for investigation. This includes inspectors from the Crime Branch along with experts in cyber and accounts. After this, the police arrested Ilham's wife, Arshi, on February 19 and sent her to jail. However, Arshi also came out on bail on March 28. 53 fake accounts came to light during investigation After this, ASP Vikram Dahiya intensified the investigation. CO City Deepak Chaturvedi also interrogated several times. This brought information to light. Ilham had created a total of 53 fake accounts not only in his wife Arshi's account, but also in the names of his two other wives, sister-in-law, mother-in-law, and acquaintances. Out of these, the police arrested 7 accused on May 1 and sent them to jail. Around ₹8.15 crore rupees were transferred to their accounts. This money was sent in the name of salary and for fake work done at the college. The police have frozen an amount of ₹5 crore 50 lakh deposited in different bank accounts. The noteworthy thing here was that Ilham sent all the money only to the accounts of his female relatives. Behind this, Ilham's belief was that getting verification done for women was easier than verification for men. The treasury does not have any tools to catch fake accounts Now the question is, did the Treasury Department never investigate fake accounts? Regarding this, Senior Treasury Officer Sanjay Yadav says our job is only to process bills. All investigations and verifications come through DIOS. We don't have any tool through which we can know that an account is taking money fraudulently. The entire attempt at fraud happens from the DIOS office itself; all the fraud has happened there. Meanwhile, Senior Journalist Keshav Aggarwal says there are many questions raised in the entire matter. After all, how can a peon be given the work of salary bills and token generation? There must be an authorized employee for this work. Who is that person? What was their role? Besides this, till now, only Ilham has been made an accused in this case. Those who gave approval, signed, transferred money - don't those people have any hand in it? The police should also tell who else is involved in this?

stories.title: After Bengal victory, BJP sets sights on UP:Focus on women in organisation, cabinet expansion; SP in crosshairs
stories.summary: 'The Samajwadi Party blocked women's reservation in Parliament; it will also have to face the anger of women in UP. The anti-women Samajwadi Party can never wash away its sins by doing anything.' - PM Modi It was a day to celebrate the historic victory in West Bengal. However, during this time, Prime Minister Narendra Modi, by taking the name of SP, made it clear that the next mission is UP itself. Modi has indicated that the BJP will focus entirely on UP. A glimpse of this will also be seen in the expansion of the Yogi cabinet and the formation of a new team of BJP state president Pankaj Chaudhary. Read the full report After the setback in the Lok Sabha elections-2024, the BJP registered victories in the Haryana, Maharashtra, and Delhi assembly elections. Now, the party has also achieved a big victory in Assam, West Bengal, and Puducherry. However, the party did not succeed in Kerala and Tamil Nadu. BJP or NDA governments are in power in 22 states of the country. Elections are to be held in UP, Uttarakhand, Goa, Punjab, and Manipur in 2027. Of these, BJP governments are in power in UP, Uttarakhand, and Goa. Political experts believe that among these, the UP election is most important for PM Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah, and BJP President Nitin Nabin. BJP knows that its dominance at the center will remain only if its government stays in UP. Therefore, now the party and government will put all their strength into hoisting the saffron flag for the third time in UP in 2027. BJP targets SP, will blame the Women's Bill After the passage of the Women’s Reservation Amendment Bill in the Lok Sabha, Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the nation and criticised the Samajwadi Party (SP). He said the party had an opportunity to shed its “anti-women” image but failed to do so. Referring to Ram Manohar Lohia, he added that SP had already moved away from his ideals and, by opposing the bill, had undermined his vision. He asserted that SP’s stance against women’s reservation would not be forgotten by women in Uttar Pradesh and across the country. The Prime Minister reiterated these remarks at the BJP headquarters while addressing party workers celebrating victories in West Bengal, Assam, and Puducherry. Political observers believe this messaging indicates that his political focus is now shifting towards Uttar Pradesh. What will BJP do for a hat-trick in UP, where and what impact will be seen... 1- Impact on Government and Organization: BJP wants to form a government in UP for the third time at any cost. For this, it is ready to take risks at any level. Political experts believe that a glimpse of this can be seen in the expansion of Yogi's cabinet. In this, ministers who have not lived up to the expectations of the government, organization, workers, and public may be removed. Some new faces may be given a place to reduce anti-incumbency. Along with keeping in mind caste equations, there will also be an attempt to consolidate the women's vote bank. The number of women ministers can be increased. Such faces will be made ministers who can benefit the BJP in the region along with their caste. Meanwhile, in the new team of State BJP President Pankaj Chaudhary, leaders will be included on the same basis. The number of women in the state team can also be more than before. People who can do better election management will get a place in the team. 2- Organization In-charge to be Announced Soon: In UP BJP, no organization in-charge has been appointed for the past two years. Sometimes, National General Secretary Vinod Tawde, and sometimes National General Secretary Tarun Chugh, have been sent to UP from time to time. According to party sources, in the coming days, a senior office bearer may be appointed as the in-charge of UP by the central leadership. After this, in-charges will also be appointed for the assembly elections. A central minister will be made the BJP's election in-charge in UP. 3- Issues of Development, Nationalism, and Employment: The BJP government in UP has been moving forward with the issues of development, nationalism, and employment since January. In February, the Meerut Metro and Namo Bharat Train were launched. The foundation stone of the country's first semiconductor park was laid in Noida. Jewar Airport was inaugurated in March, and the Ganga Expressway in April. Meanwhile, President Droupadi Murmu installed the Ram Yantra at the Ram Temple in Ayodhya. Events are also being organized by the government on Hindu festivals and celebrations. At the same time, new recruitments are being announced almost every week by the Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC), Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC), Police Recruitment Board, and Education Service Selection Commission. 4. Government sending message of unity: After the coordination meeting held in March in the presence of RSS Joint General Secretary Arun Kumar, the government is sending a message of complete unity. No minister is making any statement that shows any tug-of-war within the government. Not only this, but NDA's allied parties are also now avoiding making statements about the alliance. Deputy CMs Keshav Prasad Maurya and Brajesh Pathak are also attacking SP. 5. CM Yogi will tour the state: Besides this, CM Yogi Adityanath is going to start touring the state in a few days. The CM will reach every district to lay foundation stones and inaugurate development projects, as well as assess the ground situation. Meanwhile, State President Pankaj Chaudhary will tour districts from an organizational perspective. Chaudhary will meet RSS and BJP workers in the districts. 2027 results will determine Yogi's political future Senior journalist Ratanmani Lal believes that forming a government in West Bengal is the BJP's biggest achievement so far. Now, the BJP will put all its strength where they have their government. Among those states, UP will be at the forefront. 2027 will also be a big test for CM Yogi. The 2027 results will determine Yogi's political future. CM Yogi will also try to ensure that he is given a free hand, like Assam's CM Himanta Biswa Sarma. CM Yogi is trying to reduce discontent among the public and workers. For example, after the discontent that arose over smart meters, the government had to change its decision. Meanwhile, senior journalist Anand Rai says that after winning the West Bengal elections, the BJP's entire focus will now be on UP. It is believed that PM Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah, BJP President Nitin Nabin, and National General Secretary Sunil Bansal will concentrate their efforts in UP.

stories.title: 25 people end their lives on daily basis in UP:Love-related suicides rise fourfold in 5 years; videos emerging as ‘Digital suicide notes’
stories.summary: Around 25 people are committing suicide every day in UP. Where 4,804 total suicide cases were registered in 2020, this number increased to 9,180 in 2024. This information came to light after assessing recent and old reports of the National Crime Record Bureau (NCRB). Suicide cases after a failed love have increased 4 times in the last 5 years. 283 suicide cases due to love relationships came to light in 2020. In 2024, the number of such cases became 1,120. Read the special report Family problems are the biggest reason for suicide Looking at NCRB data, between 2012 and 2016, a total of 923 people lost their lives due to failure in love. From 2017 to 2021, this figure increased to 1754. Meanwhile, from 2022 to 2024, in just 3 years, this number reached 2746. In the year 2024, 1120 deaths were recorded due to love affairs, which is the highest annual figure so far. Meanwhile, the biggest reason for suicide is family problems. In UP, from 2020 to 2024, the highest 33%, that is one-third of people, committed suicide due to family reasons. These cases are increasing every year. In 2020, suicide cases were 1952. In 2021, this number increased to 2,235, while in 2022 it became 3,134. In 2023, 3,621 and in 2024, 3,071 people committed suicide due to family reasons. Trend of recording videos before suicide increases In the past few years, a trend has emerged of committing suicide while recording videos or live streaming (live telecast on social media). Before suicide, the deceased records their problems on camera. After this, they take their life by hanging or other means. These videos go viral on social media. In 70% cases people hanged themselves Data shows that hanging remains the most prevalent method of suicide. In 2020, there were 2,900 cases of hanging, which reached 6,371 in 2024. Out of a total of 9,180 suicide cases in 2024, 69.4% involved hanging. However, the method of taking one's life by consuming sleeping pills has also increased rapidly. From 2020 to 2024, such cases have increased by 232%. Unemployment and poverty have also increased concerns about suicide cases According to NCRB data, there has also been an increase in suicides due to unemployment and poverty. Between 2012 and 2016, 314 people committed suicide due to unemployment. In the next 5 years, this number became 625. During 2022 to 2024, that is, in just 3 years, the figure has reached 528. Similarly, the figure of deaths due to poverty was also 160 from 2012 to 2017. In the next 5 years, it reached 441. After that, from 2022 to 2024, that is, in just 3 years, the figure crossed 444. Now, let's know what the expert says Senior Consultant Psychiatrist Dr. Krishna Mishra explains - Love, lust, and attraction are three different things. However, often people are unable to understand the difference between them. Sometimes a person considers lust or attraction as love and becomes dependent on it. In this situation, as soon as rejection comes from the other side, the person is unable to manage it. Today's parenting also fails to teach how to manage rejection. Children are never refused anything. In such a situation, when they face rejection regarding their feelings, they are unable to tolerate it. Clinical psychologist Dyutima Sharma says that when love affairs break up, people experience the same kind of pain as when someone dies. However, in the case of death, people understand that things were not in their hands. But when relationships break, especially when someone has cheated, it often becomes difficult to overcome this grief. In such a situation, people's confidence in themselves decreases. How to identify if someone is thinking of committing suicide? Senior Consultant Psychiatrist Dr. Krishna Mishra explains - If a person who was previously happy has suddenly changed their behavior, then attention needs to be paid to them. Such a person reduces conversation and meeting people. They stay alone, and their productivity drops. Sometimes they also talk about dying. If such changes are seen in someone's behavior, then one should immediately talk to a mental health expert. What is the solution? Due to the internet and social media, the difference between love and attraction has diminished nowadays. Earlier, the scope of eyes was limited, but now people consider likes and comments on posts as love. That's why it's important to understand whether the feeling inside you is love, lust, or attraction. For this, you need to work on your mental health. You need to practice behaviors that keep the mind calm. Parents also have a big responsibility in this, so that children get the right understanding of love from home itself.

stories.title: यूपी के प्राइमरी स्कूलों की ये बड़ी समस्या हो जाएगी खत्म, केंद्र को प्रपोजल भेजने की तैयारी; जानें डिटेल
stories.summary: इस योजना में प्रति माह 300 यूनिट तक मुफ्त बिजली देने के लिए छतों पर सोलर पैनल लगाने के लिए सब्सिडी दिए जाने की व्यवस्था है, लिहाजा प्राइमरी स्कूलों को भी इस योजना में शामिल करने का प्रस्ताव केंद्र को भेजा जाएगा। केंद्र से सहमति मिलते ही प्राइमरी स्कूल भी अपनी छतों पर सोलर पैनल लगा सकेंगे।

stories.title: Mauritania’s plan to close private schools sparks backlash
stories.summary: Mauritania’s plan to shut most private primary schools and move students into free public schools is sparking backlash.

stories.title: ब्रजेश पाठक का विपक्ष को तीखा जवाब, कहा- तुष्टीकरण की राजनीति नहीं चलेगी, EC पर सवाल उठाना उनकी पुरानी आदत
stories.summary: पश्चिम बंगाल विधानसभा चुनाव में बीजेपी को मिले प्रचंड बहुमत के बाद सियासी घमासान शुरू हो गया है। समाजवादी पार्टी और TMC के नेता बीजेपी की जीत के बाद चुनाव आयोग की कार्यशैली पर सवाल उठा रहे हैं। अब विपक्षी नेताओं को डिप्टी सीएम ब्रजेश पाठक ने करारा जवाब दिया है।

stories.title: Lakhimpur News: नन्ही छात्रा की अपील से मचा हड़कंप, जलभराव से जूझ रहे गांव ने DM से लगाई राहत की गुहार
stories.summary: लखीमपुर के सलेमपुर कोन क्षेत्र में कक्षा 1 की छात्रा मानवी सिंह ने वीडियो जारी कर जलभराव की समस्या दूर करने की अपील की है। सड़क पर पानी भरे रहने से बच्चों, मरीजों और ग्रामीणों को भारी परेशानी हो रही है। वीडियो सामने आने के बाद प्रशासन से समाधान की उम्मीद बढ़ी है।

stories.title: US plans to hike tariffs on EU cars to 25% will hit luxury market the most

stories.title: यूपी में ईओ से अभद्रता पर सफाईकर्मियों का बवाल, कांग्रेस नेता के घर में भरा कूड़ा, पुलिस से भी नोकझोंक
stories.summary: यूपी में नगर पालिका ईओ से अभद्रता पर सफाईकर्मियों ने बवाल किया। कांग्रेस नेता के घर में कूड़ा भर दिया। सफाई कर्मचारियों की पुलिस से नोकझोंक हुई। महिलाओं ने भी नारेबाजी की।

stories.title: Miscalculation over Strait of Hormuz could ‘bring an all-out war’
stories.summary: Neither the US nor Iran are willing to compromise on the Strait of Hormuz, increasing the chance of miscalculation.

stories.title: योगी ने गिनाईं ममता बनर्जी की हार की वजहें, कहा- जनता की उपेक्षा करेंगे तो सूपड़ा साफ होगा
stories.summary: बंगाल चुनाव में तृणमूल कांग्रेस (TMC) के हश्र की वजहें गिनाते हुए सीएम योगी आदित्यनाथ ने कहा कि जो भी जनता की उपेक्षा करेगा, विकास के पैसे पर डकैती डालेगा, गुंडों को प्रश्रय देगा और सनातन का अपमान करेगा, उसका सूपड़ा साफ होना तय है। पश्चिम बंगाल की जनता ने ऐसा करके दिखा भी दिया है।

stories.title: लड़की को वश में करने को जलती चिता से खोपड़ी निकाली, तांत्रिक-एकतरफा आशिक- साथी गिरफ्तार
stories.summary: तंत्र क्रिया के लिए इन लोगों ने शमशान घाट पर किशोर की जलती चिता से खोपड़ी और राख निकाल ली और अपने साथ लेते गए। इस सनसनीखेज वारदात ने आसपास के क्षेत्र को दहला दिया है। मोपेड सवार तीन संदिग्ध सीसीटीवी फुटेज में कैद हो गए थे। पुलिस ने तांत्रिक, एकतरफा आशिक और उनके साथी को गिरफ्तार कर लिया।

stories.title: Sudan recalls Ethiopia ambassador after strikes on Khartoum

stories.title: गन्ने की फसल पर कीटों का खतरा, अलर्ट जारी किसानों को बताए बचाव के उपाय
stories.summary: गन्ने की फसल पर कीटों का खतरा है। विभाग ने फसल को कीटों से बचाने के लिए अलर्ट जारी किया है। अपर गन्ना आयुक्त वीके शुक्ला के अनुसार गन्ने की फसल पर चूसक कीटों का खतरा है।

It’s not necessary. We’re not looking for ‌a fight.” Mr. Hegseth said ​during a briefing.

stories.title: US push for Lebanon and Israel leaders to meet could inflame tensions

stories.title: 1681 पंचायतें होंगी स्मार्ट, हाईस्पीड इंटरनेट सेवाएं, फ्री वाईफाई का लाभ ले सकेंगे ग्रामीण
stories.summary: यूपी में 1681 पंचायतें स्मार्ट होंगी। ग्राम पंचायतों में अप्टिकल फाइबर के तहत केबिल डाली जा चुकी है। हर ग्राम पंचायत के मिनी सचिवालय में कनेक्शन किया जा रहा है। इंटरनेट सेवाएं लेने वाले लोग वाईफाई ले सकेंगे। यह सेवा ग्रामीणों को निशुल्क दी जाएगी।

stories.title: अयोध्या में तमिलनाडु के तीर्थयात्रियों की बस पलटी, दंपती की मौत; अम्बेडकरनगर में स्कूल बस एक्सीडेंट
stories.summary: अयोध्या जा रही बस जहां अयोध्या-लखनऊ हाईवे पर रुदौली क्षेत्र के रोजा गांव के पास बेकाबू होकर पलट गई। वहीं अम्बेडकरनगर में एक स्कूल बस अनियंत्रित होकर सड़क किनारे खाई में लुढ़क गई और पेड़ से टकराकर अटक गई। बस में सवार सभी बच्चे सुरक्षित बच गए, जबकि एक महिला शिक्षिका को मामूली चोटें आई हैं।

stories.title: India, Japan hold key meeting on healthcare in Delhi

stories.summary: गोरखपुर में एक कार्यक्रम के दौरान सीएम योगी आदित्यनाथ ने सांसद रवि किशन की मानद PhD पर मजाकिया अंदाज में चुटकी ली। उन्होंने कहा कि मानद डिग्री के साथ प्रोफेसर या डॉक्टर नहीं लिखा जा सकता, इसे सिर्फ सम्मान के रूप में रखा जा सकता है। इस पर सभागार ठहाकों से गूंज उठा।

stories.title: Army steps in to help visually impaired baba:Fluent English speaker to get eye treatment in Agra; claims PhD and NDA teaching experience
stories.summary: The Army will treat 80-year-old Santosh Goyal from Agra, who speaks fluent English. On Tuesday, Army personnel took him to the Command Hospital. Santosh Goyal's both eyes are damaged. He cannot see. On April 2, a video of Santosh Goyal surfaced. It was shot by GST Additional Commissioner Ajay Mishra. Santosh narrated his story. He said that he had done his PhD in English in 1971. He used to teach at the National Defence Academy (NDA) Khadakwasla, Pune. He was at NDA for 3 years, the board removed him when he lost his eyesight Santosh Goyal had claimed, "I was a teacher in the Army Education Corps. My students today are serving the nation as Lieutenants, Captains, Majors, and even Generals in the Indian Army." He stated that after serving in the NDA for 3 years, he lost his eyesight. Because of this, he was dismissed from his job. He also said that if his service had been completed for 15 years, he would be receiving a respectable pension today. At this time, he would be receiving a pension of about 80 thousand rupees per month. Santosh told Ajay Mishra, Additional Commissioner of GST, that he cannot eat roti because he has no teeth. Therefore, he fills his stomach with the 'bhog' (dhokla and ladoo) received from the nearby Deviram Mithan Bhandar. Neighbors don't trust Santosh's claims, Army will investigate Currently, people in the neighborhood are not trusting Santosh Goyal's claims. People say they don't know whether he was a teacher in the NDA or not. For years, they have been seeing 'Baba' (referring to Santosh) coming and going here every day. Relatives have also kept their distance from him. People say that the house where Baba lived belongs to his relative. However, those living in the house are denying any kind of relationship. Army personnel arrived at Santosh Goyal's house on Sunday. They took him away in their vehicle. It is being reported that the army is treating his eyes. Along with this, he is also being interrogated. Now know about the house Santosh Goyal lives in Nagla Padi, New Agra. At the end of a lane, 150 meters inside from the main road, there is a small house. Baba lives in this house. However, the people living in the house are denying any relationship with him. They say that Baba often comes to their place to spend the night. But they don't know anything about him. Baba is educated, but whether he worked in NDA or not, they don't know. After some conversation, Santosh Goyal's relatives went inside the house and closed the gate. Dainik Bhaskar's team questioned several people living within a 200-meter radius of this house. Neighbor Rambabu said, they have been living here for approximately 15 years. But he has never seen Santosh Goyal in a military uniform nor going to work. Rambabu said - Every morning we see Baba going somewhere and returning in the evening. Sometimes I have definitely seen him talking to someone in English. Rambabu says - Santosh Goyal seems educated, but he never did a job. He also mentioned that a young man from the house where Santosh Goyal lives drops him somewhere on his scooter every day, and he returns by rickshaw in the evening. He says that he manages his expenses by asking for help from someone around Shah Market. Baba always stayed in dirty, tattered clothes Soni Verma, the owner of the shop located at the street corner, says that he has been seeing Baba Santosh Goyal here for almost 48 years. I have neither seen nor heard that Baba ever worked. He said that he has been seeing Baba in dirty clothes and a dirty condition for years. Came into the limelight after going viral Shopkeeper Shekhar, located barely 150 meters before Baba's house in Nagla Padi, said, "Ever since Baba's video went viral on social media, many YouTubers have come to make his video. After the army took him with them, YouTubers stopped coming. Before that, when Baba's video went viral, there was a queue of people wanting to make his video." Shekhar also says that people nearby didn't know much about him before. Most people didn't know that he could speak so much English.

stories.title: 50 quintals of garbage dumped outside Congress leader’s house:Action taken after ₹2 lakh tax found pending
stories.summary: In Muzaffarnagar, municipal employees piled garbage outside the house of Congress leader Jameel Ansari. Employees brought garbage in 3 trolleys and dumped it outside Jameel's house. After this, sanitation workers also raised slogans and protested against the Congress leader. The garbage lay outside the Congress leader's house for about 2 hours. This caused a foul smell to spread in the surrounding areas. When the garbage was not removed, Jameel Ansari called the police to inform them. When police personnel arrived there, they clashed with the municipal employees. About 50 employees clashed with the policemen. The policemen first tried to reason with them, but when the situation escalated, they lathi-charged and dispersed everyone. Police also detained some employees, including Sudhir Valmiki, president of the Sanitation Workers' Union. The incident is from Tuesday afternoon in the Khatauli municipal area. Jameel Ansari, who has contested the chairman's election, is accused of not paying tax for shops. 4 shops in the Municipal Corporation's GT Road market are allotted in Jameel Ansari's name. He owes about four lakh rupees in tax. Despite several notices, payment has not been made. Congress leader accused of verbal abuse It is alleged that on Monday morning, municipal employees arrived to serve a notice to Jameel Ansari. He became angry at this. He verbally abused and behaved indecently. He also complained about the lack of cleanliness in the area. He also spoke to the Executive Officer in an indecent language. This led to a dispute between Jameel Ansari and the municipal employees. Following this, the angry employees reached Jameel Ansari's house on Tuesday morning. There, they dumped 3 trolleys of garbage outside Jameel's house gate. This caused a foul smell to emanate in the area. People started complaining about it. Subsequently, the police arrived at the scene and brought the situation under control with great difficulty. Along with this, Sudhir Valmiki, the president of the Municipal Sanitation Workers' Union, was taken into custody. Employees went on strike Upon learning of this, the Sanitation Workers' Union went on strike. A large number of employees gathered in the municipality premises and stopped work. The Sanitation Workers' Union alleges that Jameel Ansari misbehaved and abused the Executive Officer. The union clearly stated that work would remain suspended until Ansari's arrest. After the dispute, Chairman Shahnawaz Lalu, Executive Officer Rajiv Kumar, and Station House Officer Dinesh Chandra Baghel, who arrived at the scene, pacified the employees and brought the situation under control. Assurance was given that any kind of misbehavior would be investigated and action would be taken. Congress leader's son said - allegations are false Ruman, son of Jameel Ansari, called all the allegations baseless. He says that no construction has taken place on the shops. Only the roof has been allotted. In such a situation, the matter of rent recovery is disputed. He said that his family did not misbehave with anyone, but the sanitation workers damaged their house by dumping garbage outside. CO Rupali Rai Chaudhary said that there was a dispute between the two parties earlier, after which this incident happened. Legal action has been taken in the matter. The employees have been persuaded and removed. Currently, the situation is normal.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Mamata refuses to resign after TMC defeat; War of words intensifies in Uttar Pradesh politics more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Bengal’s new CM to take oath on May 9 For the first time in West Bengal’s history, the BJP is set to form the government. According to BJP state president Samik Bhattacharya, the new government will take oath on May 9. 2. 5 UP police personnel die in Haryana crash on KMP Expressway Five police personnel from Uttar Pradesh were killed in a road accident in Nuh on Tuesday morning when their Scorpio car crashed near Dhulawat Toll Plaza on the Kundli–Manesar–Palwal Expressway. 3. Yogi govt ends prepaid system, smart meter bills to be issued like postpaid Amidst growing outrage and controversy over smart prepaid meters in UP, the Yogi government has given major relief to 70 lakh electricity consumers. The prepaid system has been discontinued in the state. 4. PM Modi condemns Iran's attack in UAE that injured 3 Indians Prime Minister Modi on Monday (May 5) strongly condemned the attacks on the UAE, which resulted in injuries to three Indian nationals. “Targeting civilians and infrastructure is unacceptable.” PM Modi said. 5. UP to get permanent DGP in 15 days, Rajeev Krishna leads the race A hearing is scheduled in the Supreme Court on May 19 regarding the appointment of a permanent DGP in UP. Activity around this has intensified. According to senior officials, the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) will send a list of top-3 IPS officers to the UP government within 15 days. Rajeev Krishna's name will also be included in it. 6. Minister OP Rajbhar’s gunner accused of raping woman and forced abortions Police have arrested Prashant Rai (29), the gunner of Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar, on charges of repeatedly raping a woman over four years and forcing her to undergo abortions. 7. White House briefly locked down after armed suspect opens fire White House was briefly placed under lockdown on Monday afternoon after a US Secret Service officer exchanged gunfire with a nearby armed individual, according to the Washington Post. 8. War of words intensifies in Uttar Pradesh politics after BJP sweeps Bengal polls The Bharatiya Janata Party’s emphatic victory in West Bengal has triggered sharp political reactions in Uttar Pradesh, with leaders using the result to attack rivals and assert growing dominance. The outcome has also energised party workers across the state, who marked the win with public celebrations. 9. Bengal-Assam results multiply challenges for SP chief Akhilesh Yedav in UP The resounding victory of the BJP in Assam and West Bengal has intensified the political activity in UP. While the BJP's morale has been boosted, the SP-Congress alliance is facing a new challenge. 10. Gold prices fall to ₹1.47 lakh/10 gm; Silver rates slide to ₹2.39 lakh/kg Gold and silver prices have declined today. According to the India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA), 10 grams of 24-carat gold has fallen by ₹543 to ₹1.47 lakh. Meanwhile, one kilogram of silver has fallen by ₹618 to ₹2.39 lakh.
