stories.title: Young TV actress leaves glamour world, chooses path of renunciation:Anna says, 'Premanandji came in dream asked to chant Radhe-Radhe'
stories.summary: Leaving behind the glitz and glamour of Mumbai, the world of lights, camera and action, actress Anaa Jaisinghani, a resident of Gwalior, is now chanting the name of Radha in Vrindavan. She has left her acting career and chosen the path of spirituality. Aana says, ‘This is not my decision, it is the grace of Radharani and Thakur Ji. They pulled me from Mumbai and called me to Vrindavan.’ She said, 'Earlier, I never used to do worship and devotion to God. I used to work with big people in the TV industry. I have also worked in many TV serials. The audience also liked me a lot. But, I don't know why I didn't find peace there. I used to remain troubled. I would spend many nights crying. Then Shri Ji showed me the way.'' Anna is a resident of Gwalior Actress Anna Jaysinghani's family lives in Gwalior. She came to Vrindavan in search of spirituality and peace and has now adapted to the ways here. She has been living alone in a flat near Kelikunj Ashram in Vrindavan for the past 2 years. She has completely given up her acting career. After coming to Vrindavan, not just Anna's mind, but even her attire has changed. Now she wears simple clothes. She wears a tulsi garland around her neck and earrings made of tulsi wood with the name Radha written on them. She applies the tilak of the Radhavallabh sect and sandalwood on her forehead. She keeps chanting the name of Radha with a rosary in her hand. Reached ISKCON during acting course Anna Jaysinghani, who went to Mumbai to learn acting, had her life completely transformed after connecting with ISKCON. Anna says - During my acting course at Ekta Kapoor's Balaji Telefilms, some of my friends used to go to ISKCON. I also came to the temple for the first time with them. That's where spirituality began in my life. Life changed through 'Naam Jap' Anna says, “In the beginning, I only used to go to the temple. I didn't do regular chanting or use prayer beads. I used to eat onions and garlic. But, I attended Bhagavad Gita classes by acharyas at ISKCON. Then I understood that chanting the name can bring salvation to life. After that, I started chanting with beads and adopted a sattvic lifestyle. Gradually, I even stopped eating onions and garlic.” On giving up non-veg, she says Killing living beings is a sin She said, “That's when I understood that eating non-veg is wrong. Filling one's stomach by killing a living being is a sin. Just as one fears for their own child, every living being's family must also feel pain. This is the biggest crime. These are the doors to hell. This is where the change came within me. With this thought, I gave up non-veg.” Got work in TV, but found peace here Anna said, “I worked in 'Savdhaan India', 'Fear Files' and Sony channel's show 'Dekha Ek Khwaab'. Aruna Irani ma'am was also in it. In 'Dekha Ek Khwaab' my character was named 'Chikki'. Which gave me a lot of recognition. People started recognizing me. The audience liked me a lot, During this time too, I used to go to ISKCON. But as they say, we want something and something else happens. Everything happens by God's will. We wanted that today we are on the small screen, tomorrow we'll come on the big screen. But, Thakurji held my hand and pulled me. Gradually he made me realize, all these are material things," she added. Mumbai's 'Reel Life', Vrindavan's 'Real Life' Explaining the difference between life in Mumbai and Vrindavan, Anna says - Vrindavan cannot be compared with anything. Life in Vrindavan is simple. Life in Mumbai is about show-off. There is reel life there and real life here. There we used to think about what people would say. Whereas in Vrindavan it feels like only Krishna is watching us. There your fake identity will be visible. But in Vrindavan, that form of yours will emerge which God has really made you. Once Sant Premanand Maharaj came in my dream Anna Jaysinghani says - I remained associated with ISKCON for about 2 years. After that, I started going to Keli Kunj. When people asked what happened, I would only say that this is Shri Ji's wish. One day Premanand Maharaj came in my dream. His coming in the dream was no small matter. When the dream came, I was very troubled at that time. Many times I would start crying. I used to feel very anxious and restless. Many times I even felt like leaving Vrindavan. Without the guru's initiation, one cannot attain God. That's why I was in search of a guru. Then one day I spoke my heart's matter to Shri Ji, asking who is my guru? Then Shri Ji heard my heart's matter and that very night I had Maharaj Ji's dream and then everything changed. In the dream itself, Maharaj Ji explained to me. In the dream itself, he gave me the guru mantra for naam japa. Since then I found the goal of life. My family is with me, I wasted a lot of time Anna Jaysingani says - Ever since I walked on the path of spirituality, my family has supported me. When I came to Vrindavan, before that no one in our house was in the line of devotion. Today my mother chants the name. She has given up making and eating onion-garlic at home. Today the path has changed. Whenever I see photos-videos of the limelight, I laugh thinking where was I? If I had received Maharaj ji's refuge at that time, my time would not have been wasted. But, at that time there was no knowledge. When I gained knowledge by listening to Maharaj ji's discourses, then I understood what I was doing. Anna, while sharing her life experiences with the youth, says to chant the name. Whenever you get time, chant the name of whichever God you believe in.

stories.title: MP tourism has no weather alert system for cruise boats:Bhaskar reveals major lapses, false claims in Jabalpur boat tragedy
stories.summary: A probe into the Bargi Dam cruise accident in Jabalpur has exposed major lapses by the Tourism Department. A Dainik Bhaskar investigation found that the cruise was operating without insurance, as the policy had been issued only in the name of Mekal Resort. The department also allegedly failed to inform the insurer that the resort operated a passenger cruise service. The investigation further revealed there was no mechanism to communicate weather alerts to the pilot and crew. Weather monitoring was left entirely to the pilot. Despite a weather alert issued on April 30, the cruise continued operations, even as similar services in Varanasi were suspended over the warning. Passengers were not given any emergency or safety briefing. The state government has ordered an inquiry into the lapses. Taking suo motu cognisance, the High Court directed authorities to register an FIR and submit a report within two days. Ahead of the official findings, Bhaskar’s report details the alleged negligence at multiple levels. The responsibility of monitoring weather lies entirely with the pilot. Despite the alert on April 30, the cruise was operated, whereas operations were stopped in Varanasi for the same reason. Passengers were not given emergency or safety instructions. The government has ordered an inquiry into these negligence. The High Court has taken suo motu cognizance and directed registration of an FIR and submission of a report within two days. Before the investigation report, Bhaskar is revealing at what level the negligence occurred. Read the report..... Know about these lies in detail 1. The Biggest Lie: Insurance in the name of resort, no mention of cruise Tourism Department's Water Activity Head Retired Naval Commander Rajendra Nigam claimed that the cruise insurance was expiring on March 21 and the premium was sent on March 19, which was not approved by the company. What is the truth?: Officials of United India Insurance Company stated that the department had not taken insurance in the name of the cruise at all. The policy was in the name of 'Maikal Resort'. The department also did not inform the company that the resort operates a cruise and that passengers board it. The resort's insurance expired on March 21. On March 24, the department sent a premium of Rs 37,003. Upon learning about the cruise operation, the company returned the money on April 2. According to the company, 'Marine Category' insurance is mandatory for cruises, which requires registration and valuation, but the department did not provide this. The cruise was illegally operated by taking insurance for the resort under the 'Public Liability Insurance Act 1991'. 2. Warning ignored: 41 lives at stake for Rs 8,000 On the day of the accident, the Meteorological Department had issued a 'Yellow Alert' 24 hours in advance and a 'Now Cast' warning 3 hours before about a storm with rain at 60 km per hour. MP Tourism has no system to relay this alert to the pilot. For a ticket collection of Rs 8800 at Rs 220 per person, the lives of 41 passengers were put at risk. Captain Mahesh Patel admitted that he does not receive weather information and operates the cruise based on guesswork. Varanasi showed wisdom On April 29, 721 people had made bookings for cruises in Varanasi. After the weather department's warning, all tickets were cancelled and money was refunded. Here, 7 cruises operate for Ganga Darshan, which have a capacity of 70 to 110 people. Ajay, operator of Vishwanath Cruise, said that bookings were cancelled on the 29th due to the forecast of strong winds. Cruises and boats are prohibited when winds exceed 25 km per hour. 3. Safety and rescue 'system fail' According to rules, wearing life jackets is mandatory for every passenger, but in Bargi they were taken into the middle of the water without jackets. When the cruise started sinking, attempts were made to get the jackets out, but it was too late. Captain Mahesh Patel said that when water started filling in and one engine stopped, he called for help, but the rescue boat did not arrive on time. At that time, the manager of Mackal Resort was in Jabalpur. That means there was no backup plan. 4. Attempt to destroy evidence? cruise dismantled before investigation Serious questions are being raised about the dismantling of the cruise after the accident. There are allegations that it was hastily destroyed to hide poor structure and technical flaws. However, the department argues that it was necessary to rescue people trapped in the cabin. Straight Talk: Rajendra Nigam, Water Activity Head, MP Tourism Question: What do you consider to be the cause of the accident? Answer: This is completely a natural disaster. In 17 years, none of our boats have had an accident. If there had been negligence, there would have been an accident earlier as well. Question: Why did water fill in the cruise? Answer: There was a cyclone that day and the wind speed was so high that the rear part of the cruise stopped working and it capsized. Technically the cruise was fit, it had been repaired in July 2024 itself. Question: Why wasn't the weather department's warning seen? Answer: The staff has been given training. The skipper is qualified. A system for local warnings is now being developed. I could not see that day's warning. Question: Why was the cruise broken? Answer: Our priority was to save people. The cruise had capsized and it was not possible to reach some parts, so it had to be broken.

stories.title: Storms and rain in 8 districts, including Lucknow:Alert Issued for 44 districts, western UP under cloudy skies; people get relief from heat
stories.summary: The spell of storms and rain continues in UP on Thursday morning, when it rained in Lucknow and Pratapgarh. Strong winds had been blowing since late night. Clouds were overcast. At dawn, a storm began and then the rain started. Even now, clouds are covering the sky and there is intermittent drizzling. The cold is being felt due to the light wind. The speed of vehicles on the roads has slowed down. Storms and heavy rain in Lucknow and surrounding areas Meanwhile, the Meteorological Department has issued an alert for storms and heavy rain in Lucknow and surrounding areas for the next 3 hours. In the alert sent on mobile phones, it has been said that winds can blow at a speed of 50 to 70 km per hour along with lightning. During this time, there will be heavy rain. Everyone should remain alert. Go out of the house only if necessary. Relief from scorching heat Actually, the weather has been bad in the state for the past 7 days. Due to storms and rain, the maximum temperature has come down below 40C. The Meteorological Department says that the weather has changed due to western disturbance and snowfall in the mountains. Today, that is Thursday, there is an alert for storms and rain in 44 districts. Talking about the last 24 hours, Banda remained the hottest in the state with a maximum temperature of 38 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, Bijnor had the coldest night with 16 degrees. Lucknow's meteorological scientist Atul Singh said- Clouds are forming due to the active Western Disturbance over North India. Moisture-laden winds coming from the Bay of Bengal and dry winds coming from the west are colliding with each other, making the atmosphere unstable. The weather will deteriorate today. From tomorrow there will be some improvement in it. Heat will show its intensity again. Weather Pictures- What will the weather be like for the next 5 days?

stories.title: Hamirpur boat tragedy:Rescue ops continue in Yamuna on Day 2; 'please bring back my child,' mother pleads, 5 bodies recovered
stories.summary: A boat overturned in the Yamuna River in Hamirpur district on Wednesday evening, carrying nine people, including eight children. The boatman managed to save three people, but six others, one woman and five children, drowned. By Thursday afternoon, five bodies had been recovered, while one child remains missing, and search operations are still underway. A massive rescue operation involving NDRF and Flood PAC teams with around 100 personnel is continuing. Officials said the river’s depth is making diving difficult, so boats are being moved in circular motion in hopes that water pressure may bring bodies to the surface. A net-based search operation is also being planned. Relatives of the victims are sitting at the riverbank, with one grieving mother pleading with officials to bring back her child. The accident occurred around 6 PM on Wednesday, and rescue operations had to be halted at night due to rain and strong winds. Operations resumed at 6 AM on Thursday with multiple boats deployed. Victims identified, one child still missing The recovered bodies have been identified as Brijrani (25), and children Archana (14), Rani (9), Lavyansh (5), and Aakanksha (9). Eleven-year-old Aditya is still missing. See photos 5 km search operation underway NDRF and SDRF teams are conducting a 5-km search operation using boats. Divers are not entering the water due to the extreme depth. Boats are being rotated in circles to create pressure waves in hopes of surfacing submerged bodies. Authorities are also preparing to deploy nets in the river to prevent bodies from drifting further downstream and to aid recovery efforts. How the accident happened The incident took place in Kutubpur Patiya under Kurara police station in Bhaulee village panchayat, located along the Yamuna River. A wedding had taken place on Tuesday in the village. On Wednesday evening, after the bride’s farewell, nine people including boatman Dheeru crossed the river by boat to visit relatives on the other side. After eating watermelon and cucumber, they were returning when the boat lost balance in the river and capsized. The boat was being operated by Dheeru, who managed to rescue three people, but six others drowned.

stories.title: Vinesh says ‘Jhukane ki taqat nahi kisi talwar mein’:Brij Bhushan calls it a ‘drama’, wrestler denied entry to Gonda wrestling event
stories.summary: The ongoing verbal clash between wrestler Vinesh Phogat and former Wrestling Federation of India president Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh has intensified, with both sides targeting each other indirectly on social media without taking names. The controversy resurfaced after the Senior National Ranking Wrestling Competition began on Sunday at Nandini Nagar Mahavidyalaya in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh, an institution linked to Brij Bhushan Singh. Vinesh was not allowed to participate in the event. Vinesh shares emotional post on X After being excluded from the tournament, Vinesh Phogat posted an emotional message on X. Soon afterwards, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh responded with a cryptic post of his own. Vinesh Phogat was planning to make her return to competitive wrestling through the National Open Ranking event. However, the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI) issued her a show-cause notice and barred her from domestic competitions until June 26. The federation accused her of indiscipline and violating anti-doping regulations. According to WFI, she failed to complete the mandatory six-month notice period required under United World Wrestling rules for athletes returning from retirement. Vinesh had announced her retirement after being disqualified from the final of the 2024 Paris Olympics for being overweight. Sexual harassment allegations against Brij Bhushan Around three years ago, Vinesh Phogat accused Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh of sexually harassing female wrestlers. Several women wrestlers, including Sakshi Malik and Bajrang Punia, joined protests against him at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar in 2023. Vinesh is currently a Congress MLA from Julana in Haryana, while Brij Bhushan is a former BJP MP. One of his sons is currently an MP in Uttar Pradesh and another is an MLA. See pictures- Wrestling competition inaugurated by Brij Bhushan The 2026 Open Senior National Ranking Wrestling Competition is being held at the sports stadium of Nandini Nagar Mahavidyalaya in Gonda. On Sunday at 10 am, Wrestling Federation president Sanjay Singh and former MP Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh inaugurated the tournament. They also met wrestlers and interacted with participants. However, shortly after the inauguration, Brij Bhushan left for another programme. In earlier years, he was often seen staying at such events to encourage wrestlers. Vinesh returned from Lucknow without participating Vinesh Phogat had travelled to Lucknow on Saturday night with plans to participate in the tournament in Gonda. However, she later returned without attending the event. WFI president Sanjay Singh said Vinesh Phogat had been served a notice over allegations of indiscipline. He warned that if her response was found unsatisfactory, stricter action, including a ban, could be imposed. He said, 'Vinesh has now become used to making allegations about everything. When she expressed her wish to participate, we took complete responsibility for her safety. It was our duty to bring her safely, arrange her matches and ensure her return.' He added that female wrestlers from across the country, including many from Haryana, were participating in the event and said questioning the federation’s system was unfair. Federation issued 15-page notice The Wrestling Federation alleged in a 15-page notice that Vinesh’s conduct during the Paris Olympics controversy had damaged the reputation of Indian wrestling permanently. The notice also claimed she violated the federation’s constitution, international wrestling rules and anti-doping guidelines. Vinesh had earlier questioned the security arrangements for her participation in Gonda. Following this, the WFI suspended her from domestic competitions until June 26. Wrestlers from 29 states are taking part More than 1,400 wrestlers from 29 states are participating in the three-day competition in Gonda. Freestyle wrestling bouts were held on the opening day on Sunday. The first match on Mat B in the 97 kg category was between Haryana’s Ashish and Sheetal Guliya. The second match in the same category featured UP’s Rajat against Haryana’s Alok Malik. The third bout was contested between Haryana’s Maan Kumar and UP’s Deepesh Kumar. Wrestling returns to Gonda after 3 years This is the first major wrestling competition being held in Gonda in three years. The last National Wrestling Competition organised here in 2023 was later cancelled by the Sports Ministry following allegations raised by protesting wrestlers against the Wrestling Federation of India. After the controversy in 2023, national-level wrestling events have now resumed in Gonda in 2026. How the sexual harassment controversy began ? On January 18, 2023, wrestlers Vinesh Phogat, Sakshi Malik and Bajrang Punia launched a protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi and accused Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh of sexually harassing female wrestlers. During the protest, Vinesh broke down in tears and alleged that Brij Bhushan and some coaches sexually harassed women wrestlers at national camps. She claimed Brij Bhushan stayed in the players’ hotel despite rules prohibiting it. She also alleged that after her defeat at the Tokyo Olympics, he had called her a “bad coin”. Brij Bhushan denied allegations Responding to the allegations at the time, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh denied all accusations and said no harassment had taken place. He stated that if the allegations were proven true, he would “hang himself”. He also described the wrestlers’ protest as politically sponsored and accused Congress Rajya Sabha MP Deepender Hooda of being behind it. Brij Bhushan further claimed that the protesting wrestlers were no longer fit to compete even at national-level tournaments.

stories.title: Tigress sits with 2 cubs before tourists:Bear and tiger came face to face in Dudhwa Tiger Reserve
stories.summary: A tigress was spotted resting with her two cubs in the middle of a road inside Dudhwa Tiger Reserve in Lakhimpur. The rare sight left tourists stunned when their safari jeep reached the spot on Saturday morning. The tourists immediately stopped their vehicle and quietly captured the thrilling moment on camera. After resting for some time, the tigress got up with her cubs and slowly moved back into the forest. Tourists witness tiger and bear face-off As the safari jeep moved further ahead, tourists witnessed another dramatic scene, a tiger and a bear standing face to face in the forest. Seeing the tense situation, the safari guide immediately instructed everyone to remain inside the vehicle. For nearly 10 minutes, both animals stared at each other without moving. Eventually, the tiger changed its path and disappeared into the jungle, avoiding a confrontation. The incident took place in the Sonaripur range of the reserve and was recorded on camera by guide Raju. The video has since gone viral on social media. See the pictures- Wildlife photographers from Gujarat were on Safari According to officials, a team of wildlife photographers from Gujarat was on a safari in the Sonaripur range on Saturday. Tiger Reserve guide Raju accompanied the group during the visit. During the safari, they first encountered the tigress sitting on the road with her cubs. Later, while returning from the forest, they came across the tiger and bear face-off. Bears avoid areas with High Tiger Movement Wildlife experts say that in core forest areas where tiger density and patrolling are very high, bears generally avoid those routes and move towards safer and denser parts of the forest to reduce the risk of conflict with large carnivores. This made the rare encounter between the tiger and the bear even more unusual for the tourists present at the spot. Tiger population estimated between 135 and 153 According to tiger census data from 2022 to 2024, Dudhwa Tiger Reserve is estimated to have a tiger population of between 135 and 153. The reserve is home to several famous tigers, including the “Beldanda” tigress, known for giving birth to 13 cubs, and “Gabbar”, often referred to as the “Don of Dudhwa”. Kishanpur Range has highest Tiger density The Kishanpur range of the reserve has the highest tiger density because of the abundance of prey animals. Officials estimate that nearly five tigers are found per 100 square kilometres in this area. In the main Dudhwa forest area, the dense Sal forests support an average of two tigers per 100 square kilometres. Distinct identity of the Terai Forest Dudhwa forest spreads across nearly 490 square kilometres and is known for its rich Terai ecosystem. The forest contains dense Sal and Teak trees along with vast grasslands locally known as “Phanta”. These grasslands serve as an ideal habitat for animals such as deer and swamp deer, also known as barasingha. Rivers, including the Suheli and Mohana flow through the reserve, helping maintain marshlands, ponds, and lakes that remain filled with water throughout the year. Tigers, Rhinos and Barasingha are major attractions Dudhwa Tiger Reserve is considered one of the richest biodiversity zones in the region. More than 135 Bengal tigers roam freely across the forest. The reserve is also home to one-horned rhinoceroses brought from Assam’s Kaziranga National Park, which have now successfully established a population of more than 50 animals. Dudhwa also holds special importance for the conservation of barasingha. A significant portion of the world’s swamp deer population survives in the reserve’s marshy grasslands.

stories.title: 6 new ministers inducted into Yogi cabinet, 2 promoted:Bhupendra Chaudhary and Manoj Pandey take oath as cabinet ministers
stories.summary: The Yogi cabinet underwent its second expansion on Sunday. Two cabinet ministers and four Ministers of State were inducted, while two existing Ministers of State were promoted to Ministers of State (Independent Charge). The oath-taking ceremony was held at Raj Bhavan. Former BJP state president Bhupendra Chaudhary was the first to take oath. He was followed by MLA Manoj Pandey, who had rebelled against the Samajwadi Party. Both have been inducted as cabinet ministers. Ajit Pal took oath third, followed by Somendra Tomar. Both were previously Ministers of State and have now been elevated to Ministers of State (Independent Charge). 4 leaders inducted as Ministers of State Krishna Paswan, Kailash Rajput, Surendra Diler and Hansraj Vishwakarma then took oath as Ministers of State. Krishna Paswan arrived wearing a ‘Radhe-Radhe’ stole, while Surendra Diler was dressed in saffron attire. After taking oath, Krishna Paswan raised slogans of “Jai Shri Ram”. Social representation in cabinet expansion Among the newly inducted ministers, one belongs to the Brahmin community, three are from OBC groups and two are from Dalit communities. There is speculation that Bhupendra Chaudhary may be assigned the Public Works Department (PWD). The ministry has remained with Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath since Jitin Prasada moved to the Centre as a minister. Yogi government now at full ministerial strength With the latest expansion, the Yogi government has reached its full strength of 60 ministers. The cabinet now includes 23 cabinet ministers, 16 Ministers of State (Independent Charge) and 21 Ministers of State. The first expansion of the Yogi cabinet took place on 5 March 2024, just ahead of the Lok Sabha elections. stories.title: 7.28 lakh meters to be converted to postpaid:Process started in 7 districts of Gorakhpur-Basti division
stories.summary: After public opposition, the government has decided to convert prepaid smart meters to postpaid. The number of such meters in the 7 districts of Gorakhpur and Basti divisions is 7 lakh 28 thousand 763. The process of converting them to postpaid has started. For now, the hassle of recharging has been eliminated, and no one's electricity will be cut off. After the meters become postpaid, connections of those who do not pay their electricity bills on time will be disconnected. After depositing the money, it will be reconnected in auto mode. The work of installing new meters in place of old meters in premises will continue, but these will not be converted to prepaid mode. The work of operating in prepaid mode had started in September 2025 The operation of postpaid smart meters in prepaid mode was initiated in September 2025. Messages were sent to consumers for this purpose. They were informed that the outstanding dues from before the operation in prepaid mode would be deposited in installments along with the prepaid meter recharge. This means that when a consumer recharged through the prepaid meter for electricity consumption, the outstanding dues of the old meter would also be deposited from that amount. Know how the problem increased While an awareness campaign was being run regarding electricity consumption through prepaid meters, even after depositing money, no accurate information was being recorded in the UPPCL Smart app regarding outstanding dues and old arrears in the meter, which was increasing the problem. Consumers alleged that even after recharging the meter, arrears were continuously showing in the app. Also, electricity was getting cut off at any time. Those who don't have Android phones were not able to find out anything at all. In recent days, women in the Gangtahi sub-center area of Sahjanwa block had uprooted prepaid meters from premises and staged a protest. Protests were taking place at several locations in the state. Consumer Adarsh from the Taramandal area said that despite continuous bill payments and running only one AC, the app sometimes shows a maximum demand of six kilowatts and sometimes shows something else. Even after recharging the meter several times in a single day, the outstanding amount does not get cleared. Ban on installing prepaid meters was imposed on April 18, but they are being installed on new connections A ban was imposed on installing smart prepaid meters on April 18 until technical flaws were investigated. Before this ban, they had already been installed at 7 lakh 22 thousand premises in the Gorakhpur-Basti division. Smart prepaid meters are to be installed at 26 lakh 95 thousand 826 premises in both divisions. Now, old meters are not being removed and replaced with smart prepaid meters, but the process of installing them on new connections will continue. It is being assumed that after converting all prepaid meters to postpaid, only postpaid meters will be installed for new connections as well. After converting prepaid meters to postpaid, messages for negative bills will not come. A ban has also been imposed on disconnecting connections. Now, consumers will get a lot of relief. The protesters were moving towards the Chief Minister's residence from Charbagh, carrying red flags and posters in their hands. The protesters were stopped by installing triple-layer barricading at Charbagh. The protesters said that the lathi charge was brutally carried out on workers in Noida. Workers in Noida had taken to the streets for their rights - getting respectable wages and facilities is the right of every worker. But instead of giving these workers their rights, police action was taken against them.

stories.title: Weather to worsen again in UP after 2 days:Storm and rain alert from May 12; Jhansi hottest, temperature rises 5°C within 2 days
stories.summary: The spell of storms and rain in UP has paused for two days. Since Sunday morning, the weather across the entire state has been clear. Bright sunshine has emerged. However, light cool winds are reducing the effect of the sun. There is no alert for storms or rain anywhere on Sunday. After about 7 days, the day temperature reached 40 °C on Saturday. On Sunday too, the mercury is expected to remain between 40 °C and 43 °C. The Meteorological Department says that the effect of the current western disturbance has completely ended. However, from May 12, the weather will deteriorate again. A new western disturbance is becoming active. This will start another spell of rain. Conditions like storms and hail will develop. Speaking of the last 24 hours, there was no rain anywhere in the state. Jhansi remained the hottest. The maximum temperature here was recorded at 40 °C. Two days ago, that is on May 8, the mercury was recorded at 34.8 °C. This means there has been a jump of 5°C. Sultanpur's night was the coldest. The minimum temperature here was recorded at 19 °C. Senior scientist Atul Kumar Singh of the Regional Meteorological Center informed- The spell of rain that has been continuing in UP since April 30 has taken a break. There will be intense heat for 2 days. Nights may also remain hot in some areas. However, there will be relief from heatwaves for now. A new western disturbance will become active from May 12. Conditions like rain, thunderstorms, and hail will develop. Condition of Major Cities Why the fluctuations in weather? The Meteorological Department says that the weather in the mountains of Uttarakhand is constantly changing. There is snowfall in some places and rain in others. Meanwhile, on some days, the weather clears up with sunshine. Such fluctuations are expected for the next few days. Its direct impact is visible in UP. The winds coming from the mountains are keeping the weather cold. They are creating systems favorable for rain. What will the weather be like for the next 5 days? Forecast of less rainfall in monsoon this year Private weather agency Skymet Weather has released the forecast for this year's monsoon. According to it, monsoon rainfall may be 6% less than normal. The normal average rainfall in the country during the 4 months of monsoon from June to September is 868.6 mm. Less than normal monsoon means rainfall will be between 90% to 95%. The agency has forecast 94% rainfall. There will be normal rainfall in June, but the decline will start from July, and the monsoon will weaken in August and September. Especially in August-September, there are indications of a more rainfall deficit. UP will also receive less rainfall during monsoon, know the reason Between June and September, Uttar Pradesh is also likely to receive below-normal rainfall. Director General of the Meteorological Department, Dr. M Mahapatra, said that this year there are signs of La Niña-like conditions ending in the Pacific Ocean and moving towards El Niño, which will cause less rainfall. This means there are indications that the south-west monsoon will be weaker than normal this year. Additionally, the reduced snow formation in the Northern Hemisphere during January-March this year may also affect the monsoon. Know about El Niño and La Niña

stories.title: QR code to highlight accident-prone zones on 4 highways:'Mission Safer Road' launched to curb mishaps; maps to point 121 blackspots
stories.summary: In Rajasthan, the 'Mission Safer Road' initiative has been launched to prevent accidents on highways. The police have issued a QR code. After scanning it, accident spots on 4 national highways passing through Jaipur (Delhi, Sikar, Ajmer and Agra) will appear on Google Maps. While driving, as soon as you scan the QR code, the distance to black spots will also start showing and the driver will become alert. Now you must be wondering To find answers to these questions, a Bhaskar reporter went to the highway and did a reality check. Read the full report The Bhaskar reporter first went to the Jaipur-Ajmer highway. As soon as we entered the highway, we scanned the QR code issued by the police and turned on the map. Different pre-marked spots started appearing at various locations on the map. Three spots were found within a 55-kilometer radius. The first spot was found approximately 30 kilometers after the 200 Feet Bypass bus stop while going towards Ajmer, at Mahla Mod. At this location, 27 accidents have occurred in the last three years. As soon as you click on the spot in the map, it tells you everything about that place, such as what type of spot it is and how many accidents have occurred. There is also a school at a short distance from this spot. People nearby informed that there is a turn a little ahead from here, due to which there is a risk of accidents happening here. Just 50 meters away from this is a flyover, from which vehicles coming down are also at speed. Local villager Narsilal Sharma said that accidents have happened here several times in front of him. When asked about the QR code, he said that he was not aware of it, but he knows this much that this place comes under the accident risk zone. One and a half kilometers after this, at Nasnoda Cut, there is a low risk zone spot, where 14 accidents have occurred in the last three years. Moving forward from here on the Ajmer Highway, 5 kilometers ahead, just past the Mokhampura intersection, a red zone appears on the map. This is a high-risk zone, meaning an A-type spot. According to the survey conducted by police for the QR code, 36 accidents occurred here between 2023-25. We spoke with truck driver Mukesh Shah standing at the petrol pump here. When asked about the map, he said that until now he was not aware of such a map. He says that if such spots are shown on the map, he will definitely use it. After this, the Bhaskar reporter conducted a reality check on National Highway Number 8 between Jaipur and Delhi. Here, about 37 kilometers from Jaipur in Achrol, the first black spot on this highway was found. This was at a place where underpass construction was ongoing. There are markets and crowds on both sides of the highway. This place had a yellow alert spot, where 16 accidents have occurred in the last three years. Raju Saini from the area said that work keeps going on here. This has made the road narrow. Due to this, two-wheelers often become victims of accidents. Black spots divided into 3 zones Police have identified 121 black spots. At these spots, 1108 people have died in 3 years. These spots have been divided into 3 different zones - Red, Orange and Yellow. According to the police survey, 162 deaths occurred at 6 red zone spots, 475 deaths at 37 orange zone spots and 471 deaths at 78 yellow zone spots.

stories.title: Why stars are saying ‘Radhe-Radhe’ to the glamour world?:Has Radha's devotion surpassed Krishna worship? People visit Vrindavan in search of peace
stories.summary: There was once a life filled with dazzling lights, camera glamour and crores earned through films and television serials. Today, many celebrities are seen wearing tulsi garlands, applying tilak on their foreheads and chanting “Radhe-Radhe” in the lanes of Vrindavan. Actors and public figures who once lived in the world of glamour are now turning towards spirituality in search of peace. From Savdhaan India fame Ana Jaysinghani to actor Anushka Sharma, several celebrities have embraced devotion to Radha and the simple lifestyle associated with saints in Vrindavan. Ana left the television industry, while Anushka Sharma has not appeared in films since 2018. Over the past few years, Vrindavan has increasingly emerged as a centre for spiritual calm and devotion. Apart from Anushka and Ana, celebrities such as Shilpa Shetty, Hema Malini, Ashutosh Rana and singer Mika Singh have also spoken about their spiritual experiences after meeting Premanand Maharaj and have become associated with devotional practices centred around Radha. This time in Sunday Big Story, we understand the rising graph of Radha devotion... The chants of “Radhe-Radhe” are now echoing through the lanes and temples of Vrindavan alongside devotion to Lord Krishna. A growing number of devotees are immersing themselves in this changing spiritual atmosphere. Earlier, visitors would come mainly for darshan at the Banke Bihari Temple, explore the lanes of Vrindavan and then return home. Now, many devotees also travel to Barsana, believed to be the village of Radha, to visit the Shri Ji Temple. Large numbers of young people are spending several days in places such as Govardhan, Barsana and Vrindavan, living a simple, ascetic lifestyle and attending spiritual discourses at Premanand Maharaj’s Shri Keli Kunj Ashram. Sant Premanand Maharaj has emerged as a major influence behind this growing devotional environment. Through Radha Keli Kunj and padyatras (foot pilgrimages), he has inspired devotees visiting Vrindavan to connect with Radha Naam Sankirtan. Along with increasing spiritual interest, this trend has also significantly boosted the business of local Braj traders dealing in Laddu Gopal idols, devotional attire and garlands. From TV Serials to Devotion to Radha Ana Jaysinghani, originally from Madhya Pradesh’s Gwalior district, moved to Mumbai in 2011. She trained with Ekta Kapoor’s Balaji Telefilms and later worked as a freelance choreographer with Thomas Paulson and Salman Khan. She also appeared in television shows such as Savdhaan India, Sony TV’s Dekha Ek Khwaab and Fear Files, gaining recognition through her performances. Speaking about her spiritual journey, Ana said she first visited Vrindavan as a tourist but felt deeply transformed by the experience. She stopped consuming onion and garlic and later claimed that Premanand Maharaj appeared in her dream, asking her to chant Radha’s name. She said this inspired her to dedicate herself to spirituality. On Basant Panchami in January 2026, she took initiation from Premanand Maharaj and decided to settle in Vrindavan. “Earlier, I was surrounded by glitz and glamour. Now I have found peace here,” she said. Anushka visited Premanand Maharaj 3 times in 5 months Tulsi Mala around neck, no longer seen in films Anushka Sharma was last seen in the film Zero in 2018. On July 4, 2023, Anushka reached out to meet Premanand Maharaj with her husband Virat Kohli. Then, in 3 years, Anushka and Virat visited Premanand Maharaj 4 times. Recently, when Anushka and Virat met Premanand Maharaj, a tulsi mala was seen around their necks. This mala is usually worn by people who have taken diksha (spiritual initiation). There is talk that Anushka has also taken diksha. Some other Bollywood stars who came close to Radha Naam Premanand says, 'Whatever the problem, the solution is only Radha's name' In the era of social media, a saint's 'simplicity' and the echo of 'Radha's name' are drawing people towards him. He goes from Shri Krishna Sharanam Society to Kelikunj Ashram every day. Thousands of people used to arrive to see him at 2 AM at night. Currently, he goes to the ashram at 5 PM in the evening. They hold private meetings at Kelikunj Ashram. Videos of these are posted on the Bhajan Marg channel. Here, there are no complex mantras, but solutions to depression, career, and family complications are explained through the chanting of 'Radha Naam' alone. This is why youth are connecting with them the most. According to Tourism Department data, currently 1 to 1.5 lakh people reach Mathura-Vrindavan every day. On holidays and major festivals, this number increases up to 10 times. Now, let's understand the business in Mathura-Vrindavan…

stories.title: BJP Yuva Morcha leader shot in Lucknow:Attacker opens rapid fire on road; supporters protest at KGMU as condition remains critical
stories.summary: BJP Yuva Morcha leader Chetan Tiwari (30) was critically injured in a life-threatening attack in Lucknow on Saturday night after an assailant allegedly fired five rounds at him. The incident took place around 8 pm in the Mehndiganj area of Bazar Khala when Chetan was standing outside his house. According to police, the attacker arrived on foot and suddenly pointed a pistol at him. Chetan tried to save himself by ducking, but the first bullet struck him in the waist, causing him to collapse on the road. The attacker then reportedly moved closer and fired additional shots at close range, targeting his shoulder and neck. When nearby residents tried to intervene, the accused allegedly pointed the pistol at them as well, forcing them to step back. The assailant fled the scene shortly after the attack. Locals informed the police and rushed Chetan to the KGMU Trauma Center, where his condition remains critical. Following the incident, a large number of people gathered at the trauma centre and created a commotion demanding the immediate arrest of the accused. Police officials spent nearly an hour calming the crowd. CCTV footage of the attack has also surfaced. Police identified the accused as Vaibhav Vajpayee (30), who lives in the same neighbourhood as Chetan. He has been taken into custody and is being questioned. Police suspect the attack was linked to an old rivalry. The entire incident in 4 pictures What is visible in the CCTV? Chaos continued for a long time at the Trauma Center With the help of local people, the injured BJP Yuva Morcha leader was immediately taken to KGMU Trauma Center. His supporters and acquaintances also reached there. They started creating a commotion. Their demand was that the attacker should be identified and arrested as soon as possible. On receiving information, Bazarkhala police reached the spot. They inspected the crime scene. Station in-charge Brijesh Singh said that no complaint has been received in the case yet. stories.title: Jhansi betting case reveals affair angle:Constable allegedly hid marriage, broke woman’s two engagements; mother claims daughter was trapped
stories.summary: Suman Dwivedi, mother of 24-year-old Yashasvi Dwivedi, has made serious allegations against constable Rajat, claiming he trapped her daughter in a relationship while posted at Minerva Chowki around nine years ago. She said, “Rajat would often visit their home during patrol duty and gradually developed a relationship with her daughter, who was then studying in Class 12. According to her, once the affair came to light, the family arranged her marriage, and the relationship was temporarily broken”. However, she alleged, “In 2023, Rajat again influenced Yashasvi to end her engagement with another boy and start living with him. Although Rajat was already married, he concealed this fact from my daughter and later kept her under his control without formal marriage". She also stated that the family came to know the truth after about five years, by which time the situation had already worsened. Separately, police on May 8 arrested Yashasvi Dwivedi and her associate Nisha Khan (32) from a flat in Royal City, Jhansi, in connection with an alleged betting racket. During the raid, police recovered jewellery worth ₹1.55 crore, including nine 100-gram gold biscuits, ₹18.92 lakh cash, 12 mobile phones and a laptop. Police officials said five accused, including constable Rajat, are currently absconding and efforts are on to trace them. First read, how the love story began Yashasvi Dwivedi, a resident of Chhaniyapura locality under Kotwali police station area, is the only daughter of her parents. She has a younger brother, Sudarshan, aged 11. Her father, Devendra Dwivedi, is posted as a Home Guard. Her mother, Suman Dwivedi, stated that in 2017 her husband was posted at Minerva Chowki, located around one kilometre from their residence. At the same time, constable Rajat Kumar Singh was also posted there. She alleged, “Rajat would frequently visit their home during patrol duties, often stopping under the pretext of drinking water or other reasons. According to her, Yashasvi was 16 years old at the time and studying in Class 12 when she was allegedly misled and drawn into a relationship”. Affair came to light when attending a wedding Suman said, “The family had no knowledge of the relationship initially. During this period, Yashasvi secretly attended a wedding of Rajat’s sisters in Agra, telling her family that she was going on a trip with friends”. She added that after a few days, the family came to know about the relationship and counselled their daughter before sending her to a hostel. By then, Rajat had reportedly been transferred to SOG. She further alleged, “Despite the posting change, the accused continued to exert influence and would visit the hostel to meet their daughter”. Suman added that due to the situation, the family had arranged their daughter’s marriage earlier, but Yashasvi later ended that relationship. After this, in 2023, she was again engaged to another boy, and the family hoped her future would finally settle. However, she alleged that Rajat later persuaded her daughter to break off this second engagement as well. Suman further said that she questioned her daughter repeatedly about why she was repeatedly ending engagements and whether there was any issue she was hiding. To this, Yashasvi reportedly said that she liked Rajat and would marry only him, but wanted to delay marriage for some time due to her younger brother. The mother added that when her daughter began expressing extreme emotional distress and threats of self-harm, the family refrained from exerting pressure. Eventually, she left the house and started living with Rajat, according to the allegation. The constable was married, he hid this fact Suman said, “My daughter says that Rajat touched me and I have a relationship with him. Now I will live with him only. But the reality is that he deceived her. Rajat was already married. He has two children. He trapped my daughter by claiming to be unmarried. After 5 years when he came to Jhansi with his family, my husband found out”. She added, “My daughter also asked him many times to marry, but Rajat kept making excuses every time. Till now he has not married. When we explained to our daughter, she would say no mom, now marriage is useless. I will not ruin any other boy's life. My daughter loved him, whereas Rajat has committed fraud. My daughter also says that she has not received the status of a wife till now”. 'If he loved my daughter, why did he run away?' - Suman Suman said, “My daughter has been trapped. Rajat was at the flat that day. As soon as he left, the police raided. When he was present at the flat, why did he run away? If he liked my daughter, he should not have run away”. She further said, “This is what love is. Rajat used my daughter. He built his own house, took care of his wife and children. What did he give my daughter? He only gave her food. Can't we feed her?” She added, “My daughter had completed B.Tech and was now doing M.Tech. She was very intelligent in studies. She wanted to join the police service. She had also recently appeared for the inspector's exam”. Found out when the police station called Suman said, "After the daughter's arrest, when a call came from the police station, we went to the station. There, our daughter started saying, Papa, I won't come home because I cannot live with disgrace." She further added, “The daughter has made a mistake. That's why the police arrested her. But the constable Rajat's crime is greater than the daughter's. My daughter has very good character, but the constable's character is loose. I want Rajat to get the strictest punishment”. Suman said, “My daughter has broken my trust many times, she only listened to Rajat. Therefore, I won't be able to trust my daughter as much, but if she comes home after being released from jail, I will accept her. However, I will take it in writing that if anything happens to my child. If there is any trouble in coming and going, then Rajat will be responsible for it”. Now read the story of the arrest Raid on flat, gold worth ₹1.46 cr and silver worth ₹11 lakh found SSP BB GTS Murthy stated, “Sipri Bazaar police station was conducting checking at Bihari Tiraha on Friday (May 8) morning. Information was received that online betting on IPL matches was being conducted on a large scale in flat LS9 of Royal City. Police immediately raided the flat with a team”. Police arrested Yashaswi Dwivedi (24), a resident of Chhaniyapura, and Nisha Khan (32), a resident of Shastri Nagar in Premnagar. A trolley bag was kept near the sofa there, from which a large amount of cash and jewelry were recovered. Cash and electronic devices were found including gold worth ₹1.46 cr and silver worth ₹11 lakh. The SSP said, “During interrogation, it was revealed that Yashaswi is the girlfriend of constable Rajat. Constable Rajat, along with his associate Sumit Sahu, BJP leader Ashish Upadhyay, Vishal Bhargav, Prabhat Agrawal and 3 unknown persons, runs online betting on IPL matches. All the people used to come to the flat and bet through mobile phones and laptops. BJP leader Ashish Upadhyay was leading it”. He added, “Cash and jewelry were received in exchange for running the betting operation, which Rajat had brought to the flat in a bag a few days ago. The distribution of money and jewelry was to take place after the IPL ended. Both women were also to receive a share from this. Nisha Khan is the female friend of accused Sumit. A case has been registered against all of them under BNS and Gambling Act at Sipri Bazaar”. Were preparing to flee leaving Jhansi Sources say that there was a dispute between Nisha and Yashasvi over the distribution of money. Meanwhile, the police reached the house of absconding accused Sumit while searching for him. Information about Nisha was obtained from here. When the police interrogated Nisha, she exposed Yashasvi. Nisha told the police that Yashasvi was preparing to leave Jhansi with the cash. Constable had run over retired registrar Accused constable Rajat Kumar had made headlines 12 days ago. At that time, he had run over retired Assistant Registrar Maniram Verma (70) with a THAR vehicle at Bundelkhand University. Maniram had died on the spot. He was then arrested and sent to jail. He was posted at Poonch police station. The SSP had suspended him and initiated departmental action. He had been released from jail just a few days ago. He had reported for duty on May 7. After that, his name came up in betting. The SSP dismissed constable Rajat on May 7.

stories.title: Scorpio overturns thrice after hitting pole in Noida:Car catches fire after crash; BJP district president’s nephew injured; friend dies in accident
stories.summary: In Greater Noida, a speeding Scorpio collided with an electric pole and overturned 3 times before coming to rest. One youth died in the accident, while his friend was injured. His treatment is ongoing at the hospital. The collision was so severe that the vehicle was completely mangled. The bonnet also caught fire. After the accident, the car's siren kept blaring for a long time, which attracted people from the surrounding area. The injured youth is said to be the nephew of Aligarh BJP District President Krishnapal Singh. The incident occurred on Friday night in the Knowledge Park police station area. The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera. First see three pictures People came out of their homes hearing the sound of the collision People present at the scene at the time of the accident said - the Scorpio was at very high speed. Suddenly the driver lost control and the car crashed straight into an electric pole. The sound of the collision was so loud that people from nearby homes and shops came out. There was chaos at the scene. The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera. In the footage, the Scorpio can be seen running at high speed. It was fortunate that at the time this accident occurred, the road was empty, otherwise a major accident would have happened. After the accident, the car was badly damaged. Upon receiving information, Knowledge Park police station officers reached the spot. Both the injured were taken to the hospital. In the car were Rishabh, son of Dinesh from Jattari in Aligarh, and Gurudev, nephew of BJP district president Krishnapal Singh. During treatment, Rishabh died, while Gurudev's condition remains critical. Station in-charge Sarvesh Kumar Singh said - Prima facie, the cause of the accident appears to be high speed. Investigation is being conducted based on CCTV footage and other evidence. The body has been sent for post-mortem.

stories.title: Maharana Pratap Jayanti rally turns violent in Hapur:Youth pushed from rooftop, cars vandalised; 6 injured
stories.summary: A rally taken out on the birth anniversary of Maharana Pratap turned violent in Uttar Pradesh’s Hapur district on Saturday afternoon. The 5-km-long rally, involving nearly 100 bikes and cars, descended into chaos after an argument broke out between a youth and a shopkeeper in Dehra village of Dhaulana area. According to police, some youths participating in the rally had stopped to garland Maharana Pratap’s statue when one of them went to a nearby shop. An argument started between the youth and the shopkeeper over an issue that soon escalated into a physical altercation. See 4 pictures of the chaos Stone-pelting, rooftop assault leave several injured Police said both sides called their associates to the spot, after which a violent clash erupted. Eyewitnesses claimed heavy stone-pelting took place from both sides, triggering panic and a stampede-like situation in the area. During the violence, 4 to 5 cars were extensively vandalised and windows of several nearby shops were damaged. Amid the commotion, some youths climbed onto rooftops to escape. Locals allegedly chased one youth to a rooftop, pushed him down and assaulted him with kicks and punches. Around 5 to 6 people from both groups were injured in the clash. All injured were admitted to Dhaulana CHC for treatment. Heavy police force deployed, two accused arrested Police personnel deployed for rally security informed senior officers after the situation spiralled out of control. Forces from several police stations rushed to the spot and dispersed the crowd. The disturbance reportedly continued for nearly one-and-a-half hours. Heavy police deployment remains in the area to maintain law and order. Superintendent of Police KG Singh reached the spot and appealed to people to maintain peace. CCTV footage being examined to identify accused Police said CCTV footage from nearby areas is being scanned to identify those involved in the violence. Two accused have been arrested so far. ADG Bhanu Bhaskar said the clash began after a dispute at a shop during the rally procession. “SP KG Singh and I inspected the spot. Two accused have been arrested after calming the situation. Remaining suspects are being identified through CCTV footage and all accused will be arrested soon,” he said.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Akhilesh promises free education for girls if SP forms govt; VCK extends unconditional support to TVK to form govt more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. VCK extends unconditional support to TVK to form government The suspense over government formation in Tamil Nadu ended on Saturday after the Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK) and the Indian Union Muslim League (IUML) extended support to TVK chief Vijay, helping the alliance cross the majority mark in the Assembly. 2. Akhilesh promises free education for girls if SP forms govt; responds to Rajbhar’s remark Akhilesh Yadav on Saturday promised free education for girls from KG to PG, free treatment for the poor, and 300 units of free electricity if the Samajwadi Party forms the government in Uttar Pradesh. 3. UP weather machines show faulty flood alerts; ₹137 crore paid to company despite warnings on system faults Faulty weather machines installed across Uttar Pradesh are allegedly showing flood-like rain alerts during light showers and incorrect temperature readings. Despite the Meteorological Department warning that the Hyderabad contractor’s equipment was giving inaccurate data, the Relief Department reportedly paid ₹137 crore, affecting accurate storm and rainfall forecasting. 4. Suvendu becomes Bengal's first BJP CM Suvendu Adhikari became the first BJP Chief Minister of West Bengal on Saturday, taking the oath in Bengali in the name of God. After the ceremony, he approached Prime Minister Narendra Modi and bowed before him. 5. Constable’s live-in partner linked to IPL betting racket in Jhansi; huge cash gold recovered Yashasvi Dwivedi (24), girlfriend of absconding constable Rajat Singh, had appeared for the SI recruitment exam and was living with him in a live-in relationship in Jhansi. Police arrested her and associate Nisha Khan after raiding their flat and recovering gold biscuits, jewellery worth ₹1.55 crore, ₹19 lakh cash, mobiles, and laptops linked to an IPL betting racket allegedly run by BJP leader Ashish Upadhyay. 6. UP gang offers fake rape case in ₹20 lakh:Kingpin says 16-yr-old will get physical with someone else, and another will be framed A fake FIR racket operating across all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh has come under scrutiny after a gang leader was allegedly heard offering to trap people in false rape cases for up to ₹20 lakh. Police sources say the gang includes dozens of girls, many of them educated, who allegedly file fake rape complaints on the gang leader’s instructions. 7. ‘China helped Pakistan during Op Sindoor’ China has publicly acknowledged for the first time that it assisted Pakistan during Operation Sindoor. According to a South China Morning Post report, Zhang Heng, an engineer at the Chengdu Aircraft Design and Research Institute, said that his team was providing technical assistance in Pakistan. 8. 'Leave your parents if you want to live with me’:Husband in Gonda says wife demanded ₹10 lakh despite family selling buffaloes to fund her studies In Gonda, a 5th pass youth worked as a laborer to get his wife to complete a nursing (ANM) course. He says that after getting a job, his wife is not ready to live with him. She is demanding 10 lakh rupees. She says that if you want to live with me, then leave your elderly parents. 9. Father kills his only 13-year-old son, dumped body in pond; stabs himself in neck after being caught A father strangled his 13-year-old only son to death in Greater Noida. He threw the body in a pond by the roadside, away from home. He came home and fabricated a false story that his son had gone missing. Police started the investigation, and when the family checked nearby CCTV footage, the son was last seen with his father. 10. BCCI warns players families to 'Refrain from posting pictures videos' The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has started taking stricter action during IPL 2026 to ensure players, officials, broadcasters, and team members follow anti-corruption guidelines properly.

stories.title: Bulldozers return to Varanasi’s Dalmadi lanes:Around 45 houses razed amid tight security for road widening project
stories.summary: Bulldozers rolled into Varanasi’s Dalmadi area once again on Saturday, as authorities began demolishing around 45 houses under the long-pending road widening project. The entire locality was turned into a heavily guarded zone, with nearly 300 police personnel deployed to prevent any disturbance during the operation. The demolition drive began around 12.30 pm amid tight security arrangements. Barricades were placed across adjoining lanes, restricting movement in one of the city’s busiest commercial stretches. Residents were warned in advance Officials of the Public Works Department had carried out public announcements on Thursday night, asking residents and shopkeepers to remove belongings from their homes and shops before noon on Saturday. Authorities said the operation was part of the ongoing Dalmadi redevelopment and road expansion plan, which has gained pace after Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath recently reviewed the project during his Varanasi visit. The proposed road, currently around 650 metres long, is set to be widened to 17.4 metres. Project covers houses, mosques and shops According to officials, a total of 187 properties were identified for acquisition and demolition. The affected structures include: The first phase of demolition had started on October 29, 2025. What has been demolished so far Before Saturday’s action, nearly 60 houses had already been razed in previous phases of the drive. After the latest operation: Officials indicated that action involving the mosques would be taken only in the final phase of the project. ACP explains ongoing operation ACP Atul Anjan Tripathi said the administration was acting against dilapidated structures and properties already registered with the PWD. He said adequate security arrangements had been made considering the dense population and heavy movement in the Chowk and New Road areas. Police personnel wearing helmets and safety jackets remained stationed across the site through the evening. Debris removal continues till evening Even hours after the demolition began, bulldozer action continued in Dalmadi, with teams engaged in clearing debris from the narrow lanes. PWD teams, backed by heavy machinery and police deployment, continued operations late into the evening as the government pushed ahead with one of Varanasi’s most sensitive urban redevelopment projects.

stories.title: 6 new ministers to join Yogi government:Manoj Pandey gets place, Bhupendra Chaudhary, Surendra Diler and Krishna Paswan also finalised
stories.summary: The Yogi cabinet will be expanded for the second time on Sunday. Six new ministers will take oath at 3:30 pm. MLA Manoj Pandey, who rebelled against the Samajwadi Party, will be made a minister. Apart from him, former state president Bhupendra Chaudhary, Surendra Diler, Krishna Paswan, Hansraj Vishwakarma and Kailash Rajput have also been finalised for the cabinet. Among the new ministers, one is from the Brahmin community, three belong to the OBC category and two are from the Dalit community. Earlier on Saturday evening around 6:30 pm, Chief Minister Yogi met Governor Anandiben Patel. After a discussion of nearly 45 minutes, Yogi handed over the list of new ministers to the Governor. Meanwhile, on Sunday, the Governor and CM Yogi will watch the film ‘Krishnavatram’ at Lok Bhavan. The entire cabinet will also remain present with Yogi. Information regarding this has already been sent to all ministers. At present, the Uttar Pradesh government has a total of 54 ministers, including CM Yogi. The first expansion of Yogi 2.0 took place on March 5, 2024, just before the Lok Sabha elections. 1- Bhupendra Singh Chaudhary: He is the former Uttar Pradesh BJP state president and one of the prominent Jat faces from western Uttar Pradesh. He belongs to Moradabad and has remained active in the RSS and BJP organisation for a long time. He became a Member of the Legislative Council (MLC) for the first time in 2016 and is still an MLC. After the BJP government was formed in 2017, he was made Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Panchayati Raj, and in 2019 he became Cabinet Minister for Panchayati Raj. 2- Manoj Pandey: He is an MLA from the Unchahar Assembly seat in Rae Bareli. He served as a Cabinet Minister in the Samajwadi Party government between 2012 and 2017. In 2022, he was elected MLA on an SP ticket. He also served as the Samajwadi Party’s chief whip in the Assembly. Manoj Pandey is considered a major Brahmin leader in Awadh and eastern Uttar Pradesh. 3- Krishna Paswan: She is a BJP MLA from the Khaga Assembly seat in Fatehpur district. Krishna Paswan, who began her struggle-filled life as an Anganwadi worker, is counted among the prominent Dalit leaders of the district. She has been elected MLA four times and has also served twice as a district panchayat member. She is considered a trusted women’s face of the Uttar Pradesh BJP. 4- Surendra Diler: He is a BJP MLA from the Khair Assembly seat in Aligarh district. He is among the BJP’s prominent young Dalit leaders. He is the son of former BJP MP from Hathras, Rajveer Singh Diler. His grandfather Kishan Lal Diler was elected MLA six times and MP four times. His father Rajveer Singh Diler has also served once as an MP and once as an MLA. 5- Hansraj Vishwakarma: He is a BJP Member of the Legislative Council (MLC). Known for his strong hold in backward class politics, Hansraj Vishwakarma has been active in politics for the last 34 years. He started his political journey at the booth level in 1989. He also played an active role in the Ram Temple movement. He is believed to have played an important role in the BJP’s major victories in Varanasi during the 2019 Lok Sabha elections and the 2022 Assembly elections. 6- Kailash Singh Rajput: He first won the Tirva Assembly seat in 1996 as a BJP candidate. Later, he contested the 2007 election on a BSP ticket and won again. In the 2017 Assembly elections, he rejoined the BJP and returned to the Assembly after winning the election. In 2022 too, he retained victory from the Tirva Assembly seat in Kannauj district. Effort to Address Brahmin Discontent There has been resentment among the Brahmin community over issues such as the Shankaracharya controversy, the new UGC rules, and a controversial question related to the word ‘Pandit’ in the police recruitment examination. According to sources, RSS joint general secretary Arun Kumar had asked the BJP government and organisation, during a coordination meeting, to address the concerns of the Brahmin community. At present, the cabinet has a total of seven Brahmin ministers, including Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak. After former minister Jitin Prasada became an MP and Union minister, one seat from the Brahmin quota in the Yogi cabinet became vacant. For this position, the party has chosen Manoj Pandey, who will take oath on Sunday. Two Ministers from the Dalit Community By including Surendra Diler and Krishna Paswan in the cabinet, the government is trying to send a message to the Dalit community. Earlier, the Yogi government had a total of eight Dalit ministers, including Cabinet Minister Baby Rani Maurya. In the Uttar Pradesh Assembly, a total of 86 seats are reserved, including 84 for Scheduled Castes and 2 for Scheduled Tribes. Out of these, 67 Dalit MLAs belong to the BJP. Know who the ministers are in the Yogi cabinet right now Space Created for Women in the Cabinet The Uttar Pradesh Assembly has 51 women MLAs. Out of these, 30 belong to the BJP, 4 to Apna Dal (S), and 1 to the Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD). At present, the Yogi government has a total of five women ministers. The Constitution Amendment Bill required to implement women’s reservation could not be passed in Parliament. The BJP has been raising this issue against the opposition among women voters. To strengthen this message further, Krishna Paswan has been given a place in the cabinet. From the backward class community, Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya, and Cabinet Ministers Swatantra Dev Singh, Dharampal Singh, Rakesh Sachan, Anil Rajbhar, Dara Singh Chauhan and Chaudhary Laxmi Narayan are part of the cabinet. Among the allies, Cabinet Ministers Ashish Patel, Om Prakash Rajbhar and Sanjay Nishad also belong to the backward class community. Apart from them, there are five Ministers of State with Independent Charge and six Ministers of State from the same category. In Sunday’s cabinet expansion, three leaders from the backward class community have been included. These include former state president Bhupendra Chaudhary from the Jat community, along with Hansraj Vishwakarma and Kailash Rajput. Four ministers were inducted in the first cabinet expansion The first expansion of Yogi 2.0 took place on March 5, 2024, just before the Lok Sabha elections. During that expansion, four leaders were sworn in as ministers. These included SBSP chief Om Prakash Rajbhar, who broke alliance with the Samajwadi Party and joined hands with the BJP, Dara Singh Chauhan, who left the SP and joined the BJP, Anil Kumar from the RLD quota, and BJP leader Sunil Sharma. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has taken a swipe at the Uttar Pradesh cabinet expansion. He wrote, “Has the slip arrived from Delhi?” He also said that the Chief Minister’s powers were being reduced. Akhilesh further remarked, “At least ask those whose cabinet it is.” He also wrote, “Will they only make reels, or will something good also be done?”

stories.title: 1 guest killed in Gorakhpur wedding:Clash between bride and groom’s sides over leg piece leaves another 'barati' critically injured
stories.summary: What began as a routine wedding celebration in Gorakhpur late Friday night turned into a bloody confrontation after a dispute over DJ songs and food spiralled out of control. One wedding guest was killed and another seriously injured after members from the bride’s and groom’s sides allegedly attacked each other with swords, belts, bricks and bamboo sticks. The incident took place at a marriage hall in Akolwa under Shahpur police station limits, where the daughter of Municipal Corporation employee Jitendra was getting married. Dispute escalates over songs and food According to eyewitnesses, tension first erupted after an argument over songs being played on the DJ system. The situation worsened further during dinner when a member of the wedding procession allegedly objected to not getting a chicken leg piece in the food. Within minutes, the verbal argument turned violent. People from both sides allegedly began pelting stones and bricks at each other inside the crowded marriage hall. Panic spread rapidly as guests, including women and children, ran for safety amid loud screams and chaos. What witnesses claimed Newly-married youth dies during treatment One of the injured, Sumit, a resident of Awas Vikas Colony in Shahpur, suffered critical injuries in the attack. He was rushed to hospital but died during treatment. Another injured youth, identified as Nepali, remains admitted in serious condition. The death has left Sumit’s family devastated. He had married barely three months ago and worked at a mobile phone shop on Jail Road to support his household. Family members said Silence and grief at Sumit’s house A pall of mourning descended on Sumit’s home on Saturday. His wife and mother were inconsolable as relatives gathered outside the house. Speaking to reporters, Sumit’s cousin Sandeep alleged that members of the bride’s side attacked him during the clash and beat him brutally after the dispute intensified around 10 pm. “He was targeted during the violence and could not survive the injuries,” he claimed. Accused absconding, police launch raids Soon after the violence, the accused allegedly fled from the marriage hall. Shahpur police reached the spot, took custody of the body and sent it for postmortem examination. Station House Officer Rajesh Roshan Singh said a case has been registered on the complaint of the victim’s family and raids are underway to arrest those involved. Police are also scanning CCTV footage and questioning eyewitnesses to identify the attackers. Wedding violence incidents raising concern The incident has once again highlighted the growing number of violent clashes at wedding functions over trivial disputes involving DJs, songs and food arrangements. Just a week ago, another stabbing incident was reported from a marriage hall in Bichhiya Tadikhana area under Shahpur police station limits after an argument over changing a song on the DJ console. Two people were seriously injured in that attack.

stories.title: Woman principal gets lawyer shot at in Prayagraj:Instigates two associates to open fire, 6 rounds fired from Thar
stories.summary: Priyadarshini Singh, principal of Bishop Johnson School (Junior Wing) in Katra, was arrested in the firing case involving former Allahabad University student leader and lawyer Rajneesh Kumar Singh. Police investigation revealed that Priyadarshini allegedly got her associates to fire six rounds at Rajneesh. Based on CCTV footage, police traced the accused and found that three people, including a woman, were inside the Mahindra Thar during the incident. Virendra Singh said the accused was produced in court on Friday and later granted bail. Raids are underway to arrest the other two accused. See 2 pictures Rajneesh returning home from village at the time of firing Rajneesh Kumar Singh lives near Shriya Apartment, Baba Chauraha. He is a former student leader and lawyer at Allahabad University. He stated that on the night of May 6, he was returning home from his village. Just then, a black Thar overtook their Fortuner on Stanley Road in Shivkuti, near the Cantonment area. Three people were in it. As soon as the Thar overtook and went ahead, the people inside started firing indiscriminately. FIR registered The miscreants fired six rounds one after another and then started fleeing. When chased, they turned left from Kalash intersection and, after going some distance, abandoned the Thar and fled. The vehicle had no number plate. Shivkuti police arrived upon information. However, no action was taken even after providing written information about the incident. The victim stated that the next day, he went with a complaint to Police Commissioner Jogendra Kumar and Additional Police Commissioner Dr. Ajaypal Sharma. Both officers reprimanded them, only then did Shivkuti police register a case at 1:16 PM on May 7. Lowered window and challenged, 'Kill them!' Victim Rajneesh Kumar Singh told the police that a woman was in the car. She lowered the window glass and said, 'Kill them!' Only after this did the Thar driver, sitting in the driving seat next to her, fire shots. Police sources say that in this case, at the time of the incident, Archie Timorthy was driving the Thar vehicle. He works in the office of Bishop Morris Edgar Dan of the Lucknow Diocese. Currently, he is being searched for.

stories.title: ‘No Muslim should eat our food’:Hindu Raksha Dal leader snatches man’s plate in Ghaziabad
stories.summary: Pinky Chaudhary, president of Hindu Raksha Dal, snatched a plate from the hand of a Muslim youth who had arrived at a 'bhandara' (community feast) in Ghaziabad. He can be heard saying, 'Listen, brother, no Mullah should come here. Whether anyone likes it or not.' After this, the youth leaves from there, while supporters are seen laughing after hearing their president's words. This video surfaced on Friday. According to Pinky Chaudhary, this is a video of an event held in Sahibabad and is about 20 days old. Know what is in the video A 43-second video of Pinky Chaudhary, president of Hindu Raksha Dal, surfaced on Friday. He is seen distributing food at a 'bhandara' (community meal). During the same time, a young man arrives there. Pinky Chaudhary asks him his name. The young man tells his name as Mulla. After hearing the name, he snatches the plate from his hands. He says, Remove him from here. No Mulla should come here. Whether anyone likes it or not, but no Mulla should come here. Meanwhile, after the plate was snatched from his hands, the young man left. While Pinky's supporters are seen smiling upon hearing his words. After the video surfaced, Pinky Chaudhary stated that the event was about 20 days old. I haven't said anything wrong. It is wrong for Muslims to attend Hindu events. I have done just that. However, it is not known who made the video. Had to go to jail for distributing swords to Hindus Pinky Chaudhary has been involved in controversies before. On December 29, 2025, a 21-second video of him surfaced. The video was from Ghaziabad's Shalimar Garden area. Pinky Chaudhary was seen distributing swords door-to-door with his supporters. In the video, supporters had swords and axes in their hands. Chanting 'Bharat Mata Ki Jai', they knocked on every house's door. When the homeowner came out, they handed him a sword, saying, 'This is for the protection of your sisters and daughters. If a situation like Bangladesh arises, it's for your protection from infidels.' In this case, on January 6, the police arrested Pinky Chaudhary and his son. After being released on bail on January 15, he took out a 25 km long procession.
